review_text: Flying from Phoenix to the Canyon via a Cessna, and then flying into the Canyon via chopper was an awesome experience.  The boat ride (more like a float) down the Colorado river was informative and gave a totally different perspective to the Canyon (i.e. looking up). The glass Skywalk  and lunch were included in the trip. Our pilot (and "guide" for the day) Elijah was excellent.  His goal was to keep us ahead of any crowds so we didn't waste any time in line-ups.  This experience was money well spent.

review_title: Fun in the Skys over Lihue, Hi
review_text:
Lihue, HI  in an Air Venture Tour of the Island.

On October 21, 2008, my wife and I took the most impressive tour of Kauai from the air.  We took the Air Venture plane from Lihue air port around the island.  The flight was awesome!  We got an up close and personal views of the grand canion, secluded beaches, waterfalls, and spactular rock outcroppings with it's vegetation.  There were no roads to what we could see from the air.  The flight was very smooth and time seemed to fly buy as our pilot pointed out all the points of interest. as we traveled.

On my openion, this is the only way to really see Kauai.

This is absolutely one of the things to do when you visit Miami! We did the Miami Seaplane tour the 1st day and it was a fantastic trip! The pilot was so nice and cool, we listened lounge music during the trip, very relaxing! We loved it!

What an amazing way to see the island. Our captain Marcus did an awesome job of giving us the detailed history of Kauai as well as hitting us with loads of factoids about each and every crevice. Get to see the island from a whole different perspective. Also had various island and movie music playing through headsets during the hour long tour. Amazing views of na’pali coast, Waimea canyon, Waimea falls, coffee fields etc. the airbus was great with its bubbled windows for pictures, they even had ginger treats, cold towels and drinks on flight for those who get motion sick. Couldn’t imagine coming to Kauai and not doing this.  For those who do get motion sick - can be a little bumpy at times, but also make it really energizing and exhilarating.

THIS IS A MUST!!!! If you're worried about the cost or anything else, I promise you that you won't be disappointed! If you're worried about flying in a smaller plane, you won't feel a thing, it's a breeze! The pilots are exceptional at what they do, and will give you great information about areas you're flying over or near. We chose to do this at the start of our trip and couldn't stop thinking about it the entire trip. The views are indescribable, and I promise you it will be one of the most memorable and exciting things you've done in a while, or ever...

review_title: A "must do" in the Phoenix/Scottsdale area
review_text:
We took the south rim tour on December 29th,2013. Westwind Air is a first class operation all of the way. The hangar and lounge area were very comfortable and complimentary coffee and snacks were offered. the check in process was fast and efficient, and then we met our pilot Chris. Chris is a great guy and wonderful pilot.  he was very happy having our kids sit in the co-pilot seat and explaining how airplanes fly. He was also a great tour guide in the air and on the ground and alsways so willing to share his knowledge and great stories.
The tour left Deer valley airport around 8:00am, we flew north over Sedona and then spent 30 minutes flying over the Grand canyon. Hard to explain the feeling you get when you first see the Grand canyon from the air for the first time, but lets just say it is breathtaking. We  landed at Grand canyon airport and quickly boarded a comfortable shuttle bus for a quick ride to Grand Canyon national park.
 We spent a few hours at three different locations exploring the canyon and facilities. After a short ride back to the airport  we boarde the plane again, and within an hour landed back in Scottsdale.
Aeesome trip, great pilot, excellent company.

Great experience for myself, my husband and our 18 year old son. 

We were greeted as we pulled into the parking lot. Given lays, took a few photos and given some brief instructions before loading into the small plane.

The sights we saw were breathtaking, picture postcard perfect. We all communicated via a headset and were able to ask questions and get lots of detail about so many of the sights. 

Smooth take off and landing. Smooth flight and our son had the opportunity to fly the plane - with the help of the pilot, of course. We loved that it was a private experience and our pilot explained everything we were seeing along the way, provided history and perspective. He was friendly and funny. Would definitely recommend.

review_title: Denali flyer tour with glacier landing.
review_text: Amazing, once in a life time view. We were lucky to get a sunny bright day and the sights of the mountain range from the plane are amazing, but the tour de force is the glacier landing and time spent on the glacier (this even after we had hiked on another glacier the day before).
We had a wonderful time - amazing views of Kauai that you can't get from any other means of travel.  Our pilot was personable and knowledgeable.

Passeio imperdível!!! Helicóptero super seguro, pilotos experientes e super atenciosos!!! Meu filho tem pânico de voar em aviões pequenos, mas ficou super tranquilo pela segurança que eles nos passaram!!!

We were scheduled to go four days earlier; however, due to the clouds we were told we could fly but not do the glacier landing.  Very upfront about the conditions.  Four days later, clear blue sky and spectacular flight.  Had plenty of time to hang out on the glacier with about six other planes.  The pilot made a point of ensuring both sides had great views.

The staff here was so friendly!!! JT was our pilot and he was awesome! He knew my oldest daughter was nervous so he would go around the areas that would cause turbulence and he flew where we could see everything but not be in the middle of them. I highly recommend this if you are in the area!! Thank you JT for an awesome flight!!!!

Wij hadden de trip van 45 minuten geboekt en dit is zeker een aanrader. Ondanks de hoge prijs hadden we het niet willen missen. Tijdens de vlucht kregen we veel informatie van de piloot en konden we veel foto's maken. Daarna ook nog met de heli op de foto
Very capable team and smooth ride.  very special views of the mountains, glaciers, and glacier highways

I had taken a family summer trip for a half hour seaplane with lake landing. The pilot had a terrible and rude attitude and was not willing to provide any conversation. He seemed to be more of the lets get it over with attitude. In addition he also seemed to be a bit racist (we are Indians) and insulting to our family.

 The tour was supposed to provide sighting of wildlife but we did not spot any. The lake landing was an added 65$ per person, but it was overcast and the pilot simply landed in a different lake than the conventional one without asking us first. The new lake hardly had any beach and the pilot did not provide us enough support to actually get to the beach from the plane without getting wet. 

In all the experience was very underwhelming with simply a take off and landing sequence. I would recommend trying some other activity since this isn't something you should rather do in Alaska. There are several other services that provide much more exciting experiences for a moderate higher cost.

We were picked up at our cruise ship dock by a driver with a van and taken to the take-off site.  Senior pilot Mike took us on an approximately 70 minute round-trip into the fiords, providing commentary on what we were seeing.  He set the plane down on the water and invited the passengers (the plane holds six maximum) to step out onto the airplane float.  Cameras were encouraged on the flight. The pilot was knowledgeable, friendly and willing to assist passengers into and out of the plane.  After the flight we each received a certificate attesting to our adventure.  The driver took us back to the cruise ship location.

We have been on a small plane before and the ride has been a bit bumpy, so I was expecting about the same for this one.  Marcus was so great, the trip was smooth, the views were spectacular and we had a great time.  Totally worth doing if you want to really see Kauai.

I've been living in Miami for 5 years now and have done a couple regular Cessna flights myself over the Miami Beach Shoreline etc.  But the Seaplane experience tops that. Taking off and landing in the water practically anywhere makes flying so much more fun. Plus, you dont have to drive far to get to the airport, is right there 2 minutes from Brickell just over the first bridge of Rickenbacher Causeway. And you're not just flying your route A to B as you wouldbe under regular ATC conditions, but you are circling around, flying very low and all over the place! I recommend FRI-SUN afternoon for all the cruise line action.

My wife and I took the K2 flight as part of our Tauck Tour to Alaska and were thrilled to see these beautiful and awe inspiring mountains. We were both a bit nervous to fly over around these towering peaks in the Piper Cherokee, but our pilot, Dorothy, was the penultimate professional. She flew our group with her expertise and provided a great deal of information during the flight. We were blessed with a clear, sunny day. Dorothy did the rest. We will never forget the majesty of Denali and the sister mountains. The flight was spectacular and will be remembered for a lifetime. I highly recommend K2 for their professionalism, courtesy and most importantly vigilance for our safety.

review_title: Great day. Great weather. Great pictures. Great people.  So ... DO IT!
review_text:
This was our third trip to Hawaii, and second to Kauai. Last time here we took the helicopter tour & thought it was great. This time we decided to fly again, but wanted a better opportunity for photography. We reviewed all the brochures, but Wings Over Kauai was the only one that offered open-window capabilities. We're also very environmentally sensitive about any place we go (yes, we pick up other people's trash), and liked the idea that the plane used so much less fuel than a chopper. That settled it!  Pilot Bruce and his wife Ellen welcomed us warmly with a Plumeria flower for my hair and a Kukui nut lei. There was a cooler in the back with water and soda at no charge. My husband is the photographer in the family, so I opted for the back seat, although photo ops from that viewpoint were also possible through the open window. The Bose noise-cancelling headphones were fantastic, and we were able to talk to the pilot while in flight, asking questions all along the way. Bruce is so knowledgeable about the landscapes we were viewing, offering history, geography, geology, and agricultural tidbits that were both educational and entertaining. There was no problem with him turning the plane for certain photos, and we were lucky enough to get shots of Mt. Waialeale when it was not covered in clouds. At 5,148 feet, this mountain is the wettest spot on the planet, averaging rainfall of 460 inches per year. Waimea Canyon and the NaPali Coast were indescribably beautiful from a bird's-eye view.  Because the plane held only 4 persons (including pilot), my husband and I felt like it was our own private tour. It's windy and chilly, though, in the back seat once that window is opened, so be prepared by bringing a scarf for your head and a sweatshirt or jacket (we flew in December). The cost was very reasonable for the one-hour flight ~ and if we have one suggestion, it's that Bruce and Ellen should offer a longer tour. Before we took off, Ellen took our picture by the plane and surprised us when we landed with with a video disc with us on the cover. The video was produced by their son, Carter.  So it's truly a family business, and we were happy to support such a venture
.
Great day. Great weather. Great pictures. Great people.  So ... DO IT!   You won't be disappointed!

My husband and I did the Cessna tour today with Wings Over Kauai. This is an amazing trip - we saw waterfalls, canyons, coastline and parts of the island that you can't see from the car. Marcus, our pilot, explained what we were seeing and answered questions. The highlight was Na Pali Coast - it was so incredibly beautiful that I had tears in my eyes. Total thumbs up for Wings Over Kauai - this is a must do when you're on Kauai.

review_title: Views are great so prepare yourself to enjoy it, wven if you have to take Dramamine.
review_text:
Gives you excellent views of the island that you cannot see on land and of places that you do not have access to.  

I ate right before and took Dramamine 40 mins before.  Next time, I will eat 2 hours before and take Dramamine 1.5 hours.  There was a small section where the wind gave us a few bumps at the beginning  of the tour and that set my mood for the reminder of the tour: a little sick.  However, the views were spectacular.  

If you can, this is a good deal.  Beautiful island!!  

Tour guide should tell more of the history.  Otherwise, good info of what things to do in each area of the island.

The scenery was terrific, but the exciting aspect of our trip was actually landing on the glacier.  On September 8, 2021, the sun was playing tag with fluffy white clouds. When we landed on the glacier and exited the plane for a walk, we were entertained by the suns rays appearing behind huge black rock pinnacles. K2 furnished us with non-slip boots that were worn over our boots, and the footing was secure.  Our pilot was very talented and explained the terrain as we flew over varying vistas.

review_title: The highlight of our trip to Alaska
review_text: We decided to do the glacier landing excursion at the last minute and we were glad we did. Everyone was professional from the office staff to the pilot. The pilot, Randy, appeared to be very experienced and skilled, and was a wealth of information. What an unforgettable experience. This was an excursion we will talk about for years.

I booked the 45 min. Grand Canyon tour for our family (2 adults, 2 daughters 19 and 13).  I had to confirm the flight 48h beforehand and was reminded of things to prepare (be in time, bring your ID, etc.).  Reception was very professional and super friendly.  This company is well organized!
Our pilot Felix was super nice, gave clear instructions before take-off and was a perfect guide during the flight.  He was very understanding and kind when our youngest one got motion sick.
The 45min. flight was really 45 min. and not less as I read about other companies.  We were lucky to be just 4 in helicopter with 7 passenger seats so we all had perfect vision.  I wonder though how the vision would be for the 2 middle passengers in the back seat.
You haven't seen the Grand Canyon if you haven't done this ride!

Lifetime experience. First helicopter ride and was a little nervous but the professional group was great. The pilot was very reassuring and very informative.
You fly over and through the Canyon and see many things that you can not appreciate on the ground.

After much comparison, my wife and I chose to tour Kauai with Captain Bruce and "Wings Over Kauai".  Prior reviews said that "Wings Over Kauai" was a better value than helicopter tours based on cost and time in the air. They also said Captain Bruce was the best pilot and tour guide.  Sherry, Captain Bruce, and the whole "Wings Over Kauai" experience was amazing. The "Wings Over Kauai" experience lived up to and exceeded all of our expectations. Captain Bruce was knowledgeable, funny, personable, and experienced.  We're very pleased with our choice and would highly recommend this tour to others.

it was excellent. really enjoyed.

my daugther made snowman in the galcier.

Denali looks beautful  from the plane. Its a must do

Unfortunately, it was cloudy and drizzling on our day of the scheduled ride and we couldn't do the glacier landing route.  I wanted to write a review and let those with potential air or car sickness, like my husband, you do not have to worry about it.  The plane is small and seats are tight but the takeoff, landing and ride itself is very smooth even with elevation changes.  We actually went through a snow squall during our flight which was interesting.  Although it was not our original plan, we were glad we decided to go up and fly over the tundra and the deepest ice in Alaska, a memory we always will have.

We booked a private aeroplane tour for two around Kauai. It was the best. Friendly staff, great pilot, a brilliant experience for a reasonable price. This is by far the best way to see the island and I can't recommend this company enough.

This is the first review I have made the effort to write for a vacation experience, but this trip warrants it. Bruce and Ellen organize this very well, with every minute of the experience being fun, from the pre-flight checks to final landing. Bruce does a great commentary and is an excellent pilot. We felt very safe the whole time.
You will not be disappointed with this trip, and you could almost do two trips for the price of one helicopter ride. We will certainly go again next time we are in Kauai.

review_text: I cant say enough about this adventure. There is so much to be said for riding in an open cockpit with the wind in your face. Absolutely one of a kind views of the island. Harry was an excellent pilot in both ways of mastering the aircraft and also allowing us to experience our flight the way we wanted to.SO MUCH FUN. Eric was awesome, unforgettable experience me and my wife loved it such a smooth ride, Eric even let us fly lane some really pictures of us

review_title: Helicopter view of Grand Canyon absolutely fantastic
review_text:
Having read some of the reviews, we were not sure whether to splash out on a helicopter tour for three of us, but we're so glad we did.  We booked a 25 minute ride with Maverick, from the little airport south of Tuseyan near the Canyon's South Rim.   We got there half an hour early.  The terminal building is bright, clean and very efficient.  We checked in and were weighed (no, they don't tell you how much you weigh - you just stand on a plate and nobody is any the wiser!).  We then waited til we were called by the pilot.  Ours was called Cory and not only was he the most handsome pilot there, he was also a really great tour guide.   

We had a thorough safety briefing and were then seated according to the plan they have, which I guess is based on the weight of each passenger to better balance the aircraft.   We donned life jackets (as we fly over the Colorado River, it's a legal requirement), our safety belts, our head phones and microphones, and then we were off.   First, we flew over the ponderosa forest toward the canyon.  My husband and I hate heights but we were absolutely fine.  My son and I were in the front and the helicopter was the type that meant we could see right down to the floor all round - great visibility.  Even in the back, the seats are higher than the front to aid visibility.   We spent about five minutes getting to the canyon and then we flew right over it.  Oh, what an amazing view!   We flew around the canyon for 15-20 minutes, over to the north rim, right over the Colorado river which looked like a stream below but which was 350 feet wide.  We could see the rapids.   Cory, the pilot, gave us great information and we were all able to ask questions - we could all hear through the headphones what everyone was saying.   He clearly has a love for the Canyon and was a really interesting guide.  He named the various peaks, talked about wildlife, pointed out the nearby 
San Francisco mountain peaks, etc.   We were very happy with the time we were over the Canyon - we'd feared we'd only fly over for 5 mnutes but we saw such alot.   We all agreed it was one of, if not THE, best experiences of our lives.  It cost quite alot but it was absolutely worth it.   If you think the view from the Rim is incredible, just fly over it - you'll be stunned.
Seeing the mountains in full view was magnificent.  The flight made me realize just how special Alaska is.

review_title: Most amazing thing I have ever done in my life...
review_text:
I know there are a lot of different options and packages available.  We did the one where it was a plane ride to the top of the grand canyon, a helicopter ride down to the bottom and then a boat ride down the Colorado river.

Everything about this was well put together.  They had someone pick us up at our resort and bring us to their hangar.  They had free water, coffee and snacks available.  We boarded a small Cessna plane and took about an hour and fifteen minute flight to the Grand Canyon.  The view is breathtaking as some of the flight is over the GC.  Our pilot got off the plane with us and guided us the rest of the day.  He took us to the helicopter place and we jumped on a chopper that took us down to the bottom of the canyon. I cannot describe how magnificent the Grand Canyon is and you can't beat viewing it from a helicopter.

Once we were at the base of the Canyon, we boarded a pontoon boat and made about a half mile ride down the Colorado River and then floated back to where we started.  We then took the helicopter back "up top" and hopped on a bus that took us to the SkyWalk.  Our original pilot from the plane was always there to point us to our next stop or tell us to meet back somewhere at a particular time.

The SkyWalk was awesome and a little freaky.  It's an engineering marvel and yeah it's a little scary.  There were a couple of drama queens out there just freaking out.  One little thing to note about the SkyWalk, they don't let you take your phone or camera out there so you have to buy their pictures.  They have camera guys out there that will take your picture, and you can chose what pics you want to buy for a horrendous price (you are not obligated to buy anything).  The problem was they were short staffed on camera guys and the ones that were there had some attitude problems.  I didn't buy any pictures out of spite.  You can get just as good of pictures from the area right next to the SkyWalk.

Next they took us to Guano Cafe to eat lunch.  Our guide said it best that it was more like a metal building that served food than a cafe.  The food was not good, seemed like a freezer meal that was only half way warmed up.  I think they would've been better off telling you to just pack your own lunch or eat at some of the concession stands at the SkyWalk.  However, there were a bunch of tables outside and you got to eat lunch overlooking the Grand Canyon which was pretty cool.

Guano Cafe was located at Guano Point.  There's a lot of room to walk around and see the Canyon from a bunch of different places here.  You can climb to the top of Guano Point and see a great 360 view.  If you didn't already know, Guano is bat feces.  This place is called that because there used to be a mining operation from this location that would mine bat droppings out of caves across the canyon.  Apparently, it is a rich fertilizer and used in a lot of consumer products like makeup, etc.  Anyway, you can see the old abandoned mining equipment and just marvel at the Canyon some more.

We headed back to plane and had a narrated flight back (about 1.5 hours).  Although, I don't believe it to be the fault of the pilot, I would be remiss not to mention that the flight back was really, really turbulent (the flight there was not).  My wife got sick and there were no vomit bags.  Luckily, we had some coffee cups still in there from the morning that she used.  I recommend taking some motion sickness meds before the flight back if you are affected by this type of thing as based on other reviews, this is common for the flight back.

In summary, this was a great trip and I would highly recommend it.  Everything from the Skywalk tickets to meal vouchers were included in the total price ($1,300 for two).  We will be going back and taking my parents at some point because this is really bucket list material.

Westwind is great to deal with and made everything so easy.  After we showed up, we never had to do anything but enjoy ourselves and the excursion was exactly as described... Except better!  A full day of adventure at the Grand Canyon and back in time for dinner.  Note that the west rim isn't the part with the national park, it is about 100 miles to the west on an Indian reservation.  Because it is on tribal land, not all the same safety rules apply, but use common sense and hang on to your family members, and you will be fine.  Highly recommend, you will walk away thinking you should have paid them more, and at least with me that never happens!

We stayed at the Grand Hyatt, and the first day I saw this Red Bi-Plane fly over. We had planned on touring the island by helicopter.  With the set-up of my wife and I being able to have a private tour....that was the ultimate. My wife was a little tentative at first, but after we took off, we both were totally hooked.  The open cockpit, being able to maneuver the plane to see the best of the island and seeing the giant whales was the highlights of the trip.  Our pilot was awesome and we were even able to fly over his house and wave ALOHA to his wife.  We will do this trip again on day one when we return to Kauai.  And my wife wanted more of the Aerobatics.  Thank You so much to the entire staff at Air Ventures Hawaii.

This tour was absolutely amazing. Our guide was knowledgeable and all of the staff were friendly. The views of the Alaska Range in winter was one of the most unforgettable experiences I've ever had. Definitely worth the money to book this experience- it was the highlight of my trip to Talkeetna!
My family and I had the privilege of landing on the Ruth Glacier. Would highly recommend a glacier landing. Patrick was our pilot he was fantastic, very knowledgeable and we had so much fun!
The Pilot was amazing and the  views were incredible.  The ride in the float plane was safe and comfortable.  Highly recommended!
An excellent experience! Our tour was on time, hassle free and our pilot, Brian, was very friendly and knowledgable about the island.

Company was so accommodating. They put us in a smaller plane with big windows to help keep my three-year old entertained for the trip. They rescheduled us to accomodate our schedule and got us up with the best weather they had that week. The pilot was very good and friendly... and quirky like you'd expect from an Alaska bush pilot. He was very entertaining. The views and glacier landing were exciting and breath-taking. All in all, a wonderful experience.
Wings over Kauai is an awesome adventure! I am not a huge plane lover and I found this trip over Kauai to be fantastic! The views and information was perfect. We highly recommend wings to all!
Jeff took us on the flight of our lives with up close scenes of Denali national park. Learned a lot about glaciers and their life cycle. We got lucky with a sunny day!

Awesome flight! Eric was very informative! As a fellow private pilot, I observed that Eric is an excellent pilot. Very safe and smooth ride!

We flew the 5 Island tour which was full of amazing views! Do this flight! Skip the helicopter tour and fly with Maui Plane Rides!!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: Awesome!!! Don't debate whether or not to sign up....just do it!! Even with the clouds we saw so much and landed on the glacier. An experience of a lifetime!

Go in the morning to get the best chance for good weather.  If you're the first flight, you get a free glacier landing.  Worth it.  Very memorable.

If you're the last person in the aircraft, you get to sit up front with the pilot.

I can't say enough about the wonderful trip we had with Westwind. We took the Grand Canyon tour from Phoenix that landed and toured the park. The staff was very friendly and professional. Our pilot/tour guide kept us entertained all day with so many interesting facts about the area.  This is the best way to see the Grand Canyon and well worth the cost!
Dorothy, our pilot was amazing and did an amazing job flying us over the mountain. The visibility was good and we had a great view of moose tooth.

review_title: I was the co-pilot on a plane over Kauai
review_text:
I don't know how I got so lucky.  I weighed the right amount.  But I got to sit in the co-pilot seat.  My friend asked the pilot to make sure I didn't try to fly.  It looked like I could have if I had known how.  Great views over the most beautiful island in the world.  The views are just enough distant to provide good perspective.  The view I treasured the most was just before we got to Waimea Canyon.  We could see from the west into three waterfalls that fall 3,000 feet from Mt. Waialiali (sp?) the wettest place on earth.  They seemed to spill from the clouds that shroud the top of the mountain.  I had been on a helicopter tour of the island before but don't remember seeing that view.
The pilot, Harry, was wonderful, charming and informative and so helpful.  The take off and landing were soft,  not in the least scary or jarring.  Unfortunately, one of the rear passengers got sick.  It did not affect me, but the persons closer did not like that part of the trip.  Very good experience for the money.
Loved all the scenery viewed. Really loved the waterfalls and all the different islands. Pilot guide did a great job through the entire flight. Highly recommend.

review_title: Float Plane ride over the Misty Fjords
review_text: Nice flight, but difficulty hearing the pilot's narration as the headphones did not work well, but the views are always breathtaking....we were fortunate for good weather.

Awesome time . Pilot Eric was great and had some great knowledge of the island . He and the entire staff at Air Ventures are super friendly and nice . Would recommend them to alll . Great work guys . Eric you rock and thanks for letting me be in charge for few mins :).
The tour was awesome. it was worth it. if you have any seconds thoughts forget you will really enjoy this tour.

review_title: Float plane ride to Misty Fjords
review_text:

review_title: Great, but small plane !  Worth doing !

review_title: Talkeetna Air Tours - A must experience activity
review_text: The tour was awesome and had wonderful experience. The glaciers of Denali Park was mesmerizing ones. We could not do the glacier landing as the climate was windy and cloudy. But still we were taken for some extended rounds beyond the point for which we booked.

it was an absolutely amazing tour, the attitude to visitors is unbelievably friendly. This is one of the tours where a Family  business makes you feel really special. There were a couple of extra things, such as complimentary video CD branded with your picture, kukui necklace, live conversation on board of the airplane ... We booked the Canyonland and arches plane tour with red tail. They were very professional, very friendly and gave ample photo opportunities. I would highly recommend this service for a bird's eye view of the Canyonland park which you can never get on the land!!!

Bruce was an excellent guide and very informative.  He asked the clients on the plane questions.  We also asked questions about the land.  

A great way to see the island of Kauai.

This experience was one of the best I've ever had! Me and my partner loved it. Eric the pilot and guide was awesome and made us feel comfortable the whole time. I highly recommend this to anyone who wants to see Maui from above. The sunset, clouds, rainbow and landscape from above is something out of this world!

We had a great flight out over the Misty Fjords the  scenery was spectacular - Dave our pilot was very Knowlegable -we landed on a very scenic fjord,Dave took all our pictures then had a great flight back to base- all our group were very pleased with this operator. Recommended.

I can't speak for the helicopter tours, but this tour was in a small plane. While I noticed the other helicopters seem to get much closer to the sights, I didn't feel like I missed out on anything. I definately think that the right side of the plane sees more than the left but the seats are assigned for weight and balance purposes. This was the ONLY way for me to view the na Pali coast because the boats weren't able to make it out there during the winter months. My favorite parts were the jurassic park waterfalls and the cathedral cliffs. Joel was my pilot and he was very friendly and informative. This tour is highly recommended!!

This is a wonderful excursion. My grandson was allowed to ride "co-pilot"(a highlight of his Alaska trip) The plane ride to the viewing area was beautiful, our naturalist guide was most definitely an "original": knowledgeable, independent and just plain fun. Best of all, we saw fishing bears!! We recommend it highly

Upon arrival, I was greeted by the ladies in the office,  They were pleasant and very helpful.  I did the Mountain Voyager tour with the glacier landing.  The pilot was knowledgeable about the area and environment.  He made sure everyone in the plane was able to get the same great views.  The glacier landing was fantastic and probably the highlight of my trip.  I would recommend this to anyone.

We completed a lot of research into which flight we would do over Kauai as a family of 4. Wings over Kauai always came up with the best recommendations with safety and service, which is why we chose them. On arrival to our hotel, I was glad to hear our concierge also recommending them to other travellers! 
We had our deluxe tour booked, but the weather wasn't so great. Bruce and Angel were communicating with us to reschedule an appropriate time which would also improve our chances of beautiful views. We weren't disappointed. We took our tour with Josh as our pilot and he was amazing, friendly and extremely knowledgable on the island. He was so kind and tolerant of our children who asked a lot of amusing questions along the way! 
The service at WOK was excellent and Mary had already emailed us photos by the end of the day. We would recommend Wings over Kauai to anyone wanting a friendly, safe and personable service!

Booking was a breeze and front staff is very helpful right up to the day of flight with informing about weather and any changes to flight bookings because of the weather. 
Our pilot Mike was top notch. He was very friendly and a had a plethora of knowledge. We got to see the top of Denali which was awesome - but we couldn't do our glacier landing which obviously is a let down....but I felt safe the whole time with Mike and wouldn't complain at all about it. Refunds are issued for non landings. I am not sure if the company does less expensive stand by flights for those who didn't land, but if they did I would hop on that opportunity if they did. 
My advice is book flight you can afford and book the glacier landing and consider yourself lucky if you get to land!! This is a great company and I recommend to all!

What can i say…. Just mesmerizing and heavenly experience that everyone must experience in their lifetime. We were a party of 4 with 2 young boys under 11. 

The process of reservation was really easy with trip advisor, I just got to pick the dates and number of people and thats it. They also had a full refund policy within a certain time limit which i felt was super nice as sometime plans dont go as per schedule with young kids. 

Once the reservation is made then you just show up on time at their office in talkeetna which infact  was super clean with nice bathrooms amd front desk staff was super friendly as well.

review_title: Great way to see the island
review_text: Go for the private tour if you can swing it (up to three people plus the pilot). A very relaxed way to see the beautiful island of Kauai. They do the same loop as the helicopter tours but it’s much quieter (relatively) and you get your own window. Great group of folks too (owners and pilots). Next time, we have to try their supercool biplane...

review_title: Grand Denali Tour with glacier landing
review_text: On all the reviews of this type of tour, in all the brochures I picked up about Denali at different places, it said "on a clear day, drop everything you're doing, spend the money, and go on this tour". I wavered between skipping it because it's expensive, skipping the glacier landing to save nearly $200, or just going for it. Well, we decided we were just going to go for it. This was one of the best decisions we've made. This tour was 100% once in a lifetime incredible. We weaved in and out of all the mountain peaks and the summit of Mount Mckinley. I didn't know how much I'd love landing on a glacier until we actually did it. Afterall, we'd already driven all the way from Seward where we had seen multiple glaciers on a day cruise, hiked up to exit glacier, and saw even more glaciers on the drive up. What's another glacier? It's completely different when you are up in these incredible mountains near the summit of Mt. Mckinley. This tour made this trip, the trip of a lifetime. Believe the reviews. If you make it that far all the way to Talkeetna, Alaska from wherever you traveled from (for us thousands of miles), don't cheap out now! Bite the bullet, eat granola bars and pbjs the rest of your trip if you have to, and do this tour!!!!!!
I like the city and water view. It was amazing to look at the whole city and beaches from the sky. I wish it could go little lower but there might be limitations.

Don’t forget to take photos! You’ll be in awe with the scenery. The best bit of my Moab outdoor adventure for sure! Flying over inaccessible parts of Canyonlands NP. Connor did an amazing job of narrating the surrounding area. The entire Redtail team is awesome.

Because of clouds, we knew we would have the only chance of seeing Denali was by airplane.  Our pilot was so informative and did an amazing job of making sure all of us passengers got to see everything he was pointing out;  It was incredible to see all of these huge mountains and then see Denali.  oh WOW!  Thank you for a wonderful experience!

review_title: We had the experience of a lifetime!
review_text: We were incredibly lucky. The weather conditions on the mountain were perfect for viewing. We were assigned a flight that was dropping climbers at the 7200 ft base camp. Our pilot Andy was awesome, an experienced pilot who knows and loves the mountain. After we landed on the glacier  and dropped off the climbers with their gear, we continued to get a private personalized tour of all the many features of Denali and her sister mountains, and the glaciers and rock features between them. Andy continually shared his knowledge of everything we were seeing and positioned the plane so we could see it all. An amazing once in a lifetime experience. All the office and ground crew were very friendly and extremely helpful. We give it a 20 star recommendation.

Great flight. The pilot was very informative of all the area, saw several waterfalls ,which I enjoyed coffee fields,Waimea canyon( like the grand canyon)beautiful shorelines rain forests a trip I will never forget.

An amazing experience!
Awesome experience it was a great time to get to fly the plane and get to see all the parts of the island

review_title: Amazing day trip GC West Rim from Phoenix!!!
review_text:
We booked this GC day trip from Phoenix as a surprise for our high school and college age kids for Christmas while on vacation in Scottsdale. (Book well in advance as this is one of their busiest times of the year.) Definitely a splurge, but with limited time and never having visited GC as a family, it was so worth it!! Karla, our pilot and guide for the day, was wonderful. Personable, professional and knowledgeable, she was everything you could want for a 7 hour trip to GC. Everything flowed along smoothly and we never felt rushed. Plenty of time to enjoy each aspect of the trip (see other reviews for full descriptions of the day). We departed just in time for a spectacular sunrise and enjoyed the mesmerizing views during our flight to GC. December was a great time to visit, warm enough with layers on and little to no crowds. (Actually, the crowded busses were arriving from Vegas around 12:30, just as we were walking back to the tarmac to hop in our little plane to head back to Phoenix. West Wind 
Air's timing was perfect.) The helicopter rides were fantastic! None of us had ever been in one and the flight to the bottom and then back to the top of the GC did not disappoint. Overall, a superior experience and perfect for any nervous small plane/helicopter travelers because everything was conducted in such a professional manner. Shout out to Lindsey, the WWA's welcome wagon, who called 2 days in advance to confirm, answer any questions and was at the airport with a big smile and warm greeting to help get our day started. This was definitely an awesome experience that we will all remember and would highly recommend.

Un embarcadère au bout d'un parking cabossé, un appareil qui n'a plus d'âge, mais alors, quelle expérience !
1 heure au dessus de Miami du sud au nord et retour avec toute la côte en CinémaScope et jusqu'au bout de Biscayne National Park avec les requins et les raies mantas.
Avec toutes les explications nécessaires de la part de notre pilote, ce fut vraiment un grand moment.

SeaWind Aviation - I'm not sure I can even give this company a good enough review!  I've never been more impressed by customer service, reliability and the excursion itself was just breathtaking.  I felt so taken care of with this company.  I traveled with my husband and our 8 year old daughter.  All three of us were very happy to have had such a unique experience.  Besides the easy sign up and communication with the company, they even made it seamless to get to their dock.  They picked us up right at our cruise ship and brought us to their very nice and comfortable facility that was complete with water station and beautiful, clean bathrooms.  We got onto the seaplane and the magic started before liftoff.  What a once in a lifetime experience!  We got a great tour of Misty Fjords and lots of information about the area.  You can see straight down through the convex windows - literally a bird's eye view.  We felt safe and it was exciting (although it was chilly in the seaplane - bring a sweater).  After the tour, we were driven right into town and told exactly how to get back to our cruise ship - it was really easy.  Touring with this company was seamless.  I'm not sure exactly, but it felt like a famliy run business that takes great pride in its company.

review_text:
Before I discuss the actual tour, a bit about Wings Over Kauai... Due to no problem of theirs, I screwed up the booking of this tour about four times. I was constantly confused of the dates and times we were available. I was a real headache, I'm sure. I spoke with a Wings Over Kauai employee (Mary?) several times, and she put up with my constant mistakes like a pro. By the time I'd finally got things settled, I was already convinced this organization was excellent.

Now to the trip... Kauai weather is fickle and we had a morning flight. The staff showed us a map of the winds and live videos to completely prepare us for risks of partial visibility or turbulence. They offered to rebook us for a different time or day if we had any problems. We chose to go ahead with the flight.

Our pilot (Mark?) was funny and happy to take a minor detour when he saw whales breaching off the Na Pali coast. The views are absolutely outstanding, and due to our altitude and flghtplan, we were able to see more than we would have in a helicopter tour. We experienced turbulence (which we were warned about), but Mark was amazing at the helm.

Would definitely do again! We recommend doing this as early into your trip as possible to get a scenic overview (no pun intended) of Kauai!

A seaplane trip was a bucket list thing for me and Seaplane Adventures delivered perfectly.
Ana in reception was super friendly and helpful and our pilot (Jerome) was so friendly and helpful and full of so much knowledge about the SF Bay and surrounding area.
As a plane geek the change to fly in a Beaver was a huge highlight.

review_text:

review_title: This is how you should see Kauai
review_text: What a wonderful way to see the island! We took the private 2-person tour on the Cessna and were treated like family. Capt. Bruce (he’s also Dr. Bruce, a retired research scientist!) and Val were very professional and took good care of us. We were unsure of this morning’s trip as the weather forecast was not looking good. Rain and clouds were about to roll in when we got to the airport. Val greeted us cheerfully, checked us in and went through the safety briefing with us thoroughly. I immediately knew that they took safety seriously. We then waited as we were early for our scheduled departure. It started to rain shortly thereafter and Bruce then called us into the office and showed us the big rain clouds over the Lihue & Hanalei area on the computer. He was very honest and told us that we will likely not have clear views over some areas. So he gave us a choice to reschedule, a refund or to go ahead with the tour (assuring us it was safe to do so). What an honest and professional business! We decided to go ahead and was prepared for a less than stellar experience. Boy, were we wrong! While it was cloudy, the sights were still wonderful as Bruce expertly navigated through the clouds and showed us the spectacular Na Pali Coast and the breathtaking Waimea Canyon. We had to turn around at Hanalei due to the storm clouds (again safety first!) while some other operators decided to go through the area. I knew this as I could hear all the chatter over the radio. A couple others did turn around and followed Bruce’s lead. He must be well respected by the flying community! We made it back to Lihue airport safely with full of wonderful memories. Thank you Bruce for your wonderful sense of humor and knowledge about the island. I enjoyed being your “co-pilot”!

We went with wings over kauai on january 21st. We had a wonderful time and the scenery was just wonderful. I highly recommend this flight very good company and the price is perfect. We saw the napali coast, the canyon, in fact the whole island.Great staff, very proffesional. Thank you so much!!!
We really enjoyed our helicopter ride over the Grand Canyon.  Beautiful views.  Our pilot was knowledgeable and friendly.  Loved it.

We had a great flightseeing tour with K2. We went around and over several peaks, flew down several glacial flows, and had a glacier landing. It was a great experience and was worth every penny. It is a memory that my husband, 8 year old daughter, and I will have forever. The pilot was very laid back but safety conscious and really augmented our experience with unobtrusive info and responses to questions. Highly recommended.

Our pilot and tour guide Dan was awesome! We had the most incredible day! Dan was on top of everything and ensured that we beat the long lines while still having ample time at our Grand Canyon stops. Having someone who is knowledgeable about how everything works and able to execute the timing is invaluable. He also had extensive knowledge of the history of the Canyon and pointed out some extraordinary things along the way. The short plane ride to the Canyon was narrated and filled with lots of interesting information to go along with the incredible views. The helicopter down to the base and the boat ride was the icing on the cake. Can’t recommend this company enough! Call and book directly. Not only will you save on the booking fee the agent was very knowledgeable and answered all of our questions. A top notch company. Will definitely use them again!

review_title: Great Scenic Tour with a Great Pilot/Guide
review_text: I liked that Chris, our pilot, showed us on a map where we would go on our plane trip before we took off. We had visited Canyonlands the day before, but we saw so much more on this  flight: many wilderness areas that were inaccessible to us any other way. It is amazing the beautiful scenery -- so many shapes and colors of rocks. Our pilot gave a good narration and pointed out things to photograph. As we flew over Arches, he also pointed out arches and gave us the chance to take pictures. Loved this tour and would highly recommend it.

TAT is clearly one of the leaders in glacier landings from Talkeetna. We took them in and out of base camp for our Denali expedition, and they were superb. One passenger gets to sit inthe co-pilot seat, and that was a very cool perspective. They are also the company that runs the schedule at "Kahiltna International" on the glacier. I trusted them with my life, and would do it again.

Amazing tour guide and Max the pilot were very nice and accommodating.
Loved how knowledgeable Kim was about the plants and animals native to the area. Both were very kind and helpful my friend who had issues walked!!
Loved the trip.

Best trip ever. You don't want to miss this. To be able to fly so close to the mountains and land on a glazier is just amazing. Pilot is very knowledgeable. The employees are great and so helpful. Plan your trip early on your vacation in case of bad weather you can reschedule. You don't want to miss this!!!

review_title: Best way to see the island
review_text: Amazing! Definitely the highlight of the 4 islands we visited and the best way to see the geography of Kauai. I am a private pilot from the UK and so had a flying lesson with my wife as a passenger- I would recommend doing this to any pilots of anyone with an interest in flying.
Amazing experience, really good pilot. Highly recommend it! Insane views and really good journey. Recommend it for everyone visiting Miami

We had scheduled the grand tour with glacier landing, but weather was not cooperating.  They offered us a different route viewing glaciers.  Disappointed, we decided to give the alternate a try.  Very glad we did.  Our pilot, Dan was exceptional.  Awe inspiring views.  Very happy with flight.
I did this seaplane trip for my 16th birthday with a couple friends. It was super fun and made my birthday. The pilot was really nice and informative as well.
We had a great time! It was the most memorable thing we did on our entire trip! Garrett was an excellent pilot and guide. We would highly recommend K2 Aviation!

We took the private tour. It is fabulous! The pilot, Ray, and his wife treated us royally. The views from the air were just great. No way we could have seen Kauii any other way.

These folks are the best.

Suzanne and Jim

Kauai is our favorite island. There’s just something different about it. It has a different feel, a different vibe. Maybe it’s the chickens everywhere, or the cattle or the more mature landscape. Just not sure. From the air, it’s gorgeous. We flew Wings Over Kauai. Very, very nice people. We were very lucky in that the other people on our flight cancelled, so we had the entire Caravan to ourselves. Bruce, the owner, was our pilot. We took off on 30, NW, turned right and circled the island clockwise. Got great pictures during a flyover of the Crown at dock. The day was partly cloudy with clouds and rain over the center of the island. The water was pure aqua blue, the coastline just picture perfect rocks and white spray and the green of the trees contrasting with the red of the soil could not be done justice in a photo. We cut inland up Wameia Canyon, saw the Jurassic Park waterfall, flew inland of the Pacific Missile Test Range main base, but cut back out over the ocean just before we go to the northern most telemetry radars sitting on top of one giant cliff. 

Flew along the Napoli Coast. Saw the trail wind its way through the cliffs, on top of huge sea caves and along knife edge ridges of rock. Broke back over the northern coast over the resorts and golf courses and the locations they filmed Jurassic World. Cut around the NW part of the island, flew a circle around the Fantasy Island waterfall, saw the cattle grazing in almost chartreuse meadows, flew back over the ship and landed back on runway 30. The whole trip was about 70 minutes, at a ground speed of around 90mph. Judy filmed the whole thing with the action cam, and I took about 160+ stills. We also ordered a video of the flight. They had GoPro’s on each wing. 

This was one of the best value excursions we’ve ever had in Hawaii. Judy did get a little queasy coming around the hills to the NW of the airport. The air was a bit bumpy, but not bad at all. Nothing like the helicopter we took in Juneau in 2001.

The experience was unbelieveable. The scenary was great. It was rainy that day, but Ketchikan has more than 100feet of rain a year, so I guess I should not complaint.

One thing worth special mention is Leslie, who is the wife of the pilot. She is so friendly. We planed to visit Totem Park after the flight seeing, and she actually drove us to the park!!! It not only saved us money but also saved us valuable time, since the cruise ship we were on only stay for 8 hours (coral princess). 

I highly recommended trying Seawind. It is simply the best.

review_title: FANTASTIC VFR Private Flying Lesson with Captain Bruce!
review_text:
I was lucky enough to take a private VFR flying lesson with Captain Bruce in his Cessna. Captain Bruce is an excellent pilot who taught me some really valuable must know info with regard to flying VFR flights in Kauai as well as a few new general things/tips that will help me before I solo.  His Cessna was clean and flew very smooth.  I suspect he takes excellent care of his planes.  I highly recommend taking a flight with Wings Over Kauai whether its a tour or a private lesson. It is truly the best place in the world to fly. Period.

-Joe Amar, Los Angeles, 7/1/18

Dorothy was our pilot and she was great! Made it a fun experience explaining fun facts of the area and for small plane, Very smooth take off and landing! :) Would highly recommend this company as we looked at another flightseeing company out of Denali, to attempt a Glacier landing, and it was considerably More $$ for the exact same experience!
What an amazing ride. The kids loved it. Great way to see the valley and the pilot was friendly and knowledgeable
Amazing moment ! The pilot and the team are really nice, the flight was perfect ! We took the one hour tour with champagne ! Highly recommand

Our original intent for booking this excursion was to secure sold-out Alcatraz Tour tickets.  Wow . . . we we pleasantly surprised by how much we enjoyed the seaplane tour.  The 30 mins(+) we spent was a blast.  The pilot/guide was professional, engaging, funny and very knowledgeable.  He even circled a spot in the bay to allow our group to see a surfacing whale!  We learned things about the history and the present about the area that we had never heard before.  And, of course, we saw S.F. from a perspective that few get to see.  This is much more enjoyable than a 10-15 helicopter ride.  

This ended up the highlight of our 4 days in the city.  Highly recommend it!

We stepped off our cruise ship and chose this tour as it sounded good and reasonably priced compared to price on board the ship where we had not booked earlier. We were immediately transported from there in a mini van to the Taquan flying area. After a very short wait where we could have coffee or use the restroom we were allotted a plane and pilot. We were a group of 9 all together and were allotted one of the larger seaplanes. Our pilot was Adam - an experienced flier who also gave us great commentary and had a great sense of humour! He landed on a fjord too and we got a great view and photos!
All in all it was a great experience - one not to be missed!

review_title: Good trip but not clear details
review_text: The actual tour while on the water was stunning! We saw wildlife and our guide, Tia, was amazing! She was friendly and very informative. I have to take one star due to your saying full day. We were picked up at our hotel, had a 3 1/2 bus ride to Page, AZ, then another bus ride to the boats. Then on the water just under 3 1/2 hours for another return bus ride. Had I been informed that the tour originated in Page, we would have stayed there and eliminated the bus ride, but it never gave me the information during the reservation process. When I did call prior to it, I admit I should have asked if staying in Grand Canyon Village was a good idea. But, the tour itself it great, just make sure you stay in Page for it to start. Oh, and you should know the picnic lunch isn’t out on the water, but given to you on the bus. Then you must go through Homeland Security before you can board the transfer to the boat.

review_text: So glad we did this (instead of the helicopter)... Quiet, smooth, amazing views of Kauai! Everyone has a window seat... Guided tour with excellent explanations! Loved, loved, loved it!

The staff was amazing trying to accommodate walk ins (Thank you) our pilot was awesome! We had a great group. Our pilot was very knowledgeable, experienced and made the entire experience exceptional..... He helped take pictures for our memories. We WOULD RECOMMEND this company to any one!!

Our pilot/guide Brian gave an outstanding tour full of information only a native would have insight into.  We feel like if we would've taken this tour early on in our stay in Kauai we could have seen exactly the spots to see and have a better understanding of the layout of the land.
For those with fears of small planes/helicopters or weak stomachs, this is a great alternative to see the island from above.  Also, very comfortable flight for those bigger fellas.

review_title: This is a two-for-one experience if you haven't ridden a helicopter and you havent been to the Grand Danyon
review_text:

They picked us up from our hotel 1.5hrs before our scheduled flight since they also picked up other passengers from other hotels. We were weighed and were told the pilot will be the one to make the seating arrangements on board the helicopter. The ride was enjoyable and the picnic was passable (they served champagne in plastic dups and commercially-bought muffins. review_title: Highlight of our trip to Kauai!!
review_text:
From booking to the plane ride, the team at 'Wings Over Kauai' are professional, friendly, and make you feel like family.  I emailed Ellen a few times and she was very responsive with booking the tour.  I wanted to tour in the Cessna, as it was just my husband and I.  Unfortunately, due to our missed flight, we were delayed in reaching Kauai.  But Ellen was very understanding.  She gave me different options and booked me on the Cessna tour for a different day.  Very very accomodating.

On the day of our tour, we reached early and were welcomed by Doris.  She gave me a flower and lei (garland) as a gift.  Her husband Josh was our pilot.  We got on our Cessna, but not before she took a picture of us.  She took a few and emailed it to us right away.  The Cessna had water and ginger chews for us (in case we got motion sickness).

My husband sat in the front and was super excited.  The tour was amazing.  Kauai is a beautiful island and what better way to see the Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon, and all the different beaches.  It did get a bit windy and Josh made sure we were comfortable.  I did get a bit queasy towards the end, but my husband had no problem at all.  I sucked on the ginger chews and was fine.  Once we landed, they gave us a DVD of the flight that this tour took as a gift.

I can totally understand why this tour is the number 1 thing to do in Kauai as per Trip Advisor.  Its cheaper than helicopters and provides the same scenic views.  Their customer service was top notch.  I highly recommend anyone going to Kauai to do this tour.  Definitely was one of the highlights of my trip.

My partner and I travelled to Kauai in June as part of a three island tour of Hawaii.  I'd booked the Wings over Kauai 'Grand Deluxe' tour over the Internet based on positive reviews and we were not disappointed.  The hospitality shown by Bruce and Ellen was fantastic and we felt more like family guests than customers.  The flight was perfect - even though it was a small aircraft it was perfectly smooth and the scenery.....   If you want to really see Kauai then it has to be by air and if you have to go by air then I'd recommend 'Wings'.  As a Scot, I also have to mention that the cost is far lower than the helicopter prices we saw.  And I must also mention Bruce's Bose noise-cancelling headphones - having suffered trying to hear other narratives in other places over the background engine noise these were fantastic.
Wonderful, friendly people!  Our pilot Bruce was so knowledgable!  Enjoyed this so much!  Better than a helicopter if you get queasy and reasonably priced!

review_title: Sea Plane from Friday Harbor to Renton
review_text: I put my 17-year old daughter on a one-way home from Friday Harbor - she could not say enough wonderful compliments about her trip - gorgeous - and her pilot - "he told us about what we were seeing on the ground and gave us some history - really a great trip."

This was by far the most exciting thing my husband and I have ever done! The terminal is beautiful and staff very friendly and professional. We took pics with the pilot next to the helicopter prior to flying. We boarded with several others and belted up and put on headphones so we could hear the pilot. My husband and I were in the back but had great views. The helicopter took off and flew over the forest and it was great. All of the sudden, we flew over the edge of the canyon and it felt like we went off the edge, but we weren't falling. It's literally breathtaking. It was so surreal, there really are no words. We flew over the majestic beauty of the Grand Canyon about 40 minutes while our pilot pointed out all the landmarks. It is 
something you have to see to believe. We returned to the terminal, took more pics, then had the opportunity to buy the ones taken with the pilot for $19, and you could also buy a DVD  if you wanted. We drove off in awe! This was expensive, about $545 for both of us, but worth every single penny! Do this for yourself!
Our tour with Bubbs was amazing!  We got a wonderful overview of the island and it was the highlight of our trip to Kauai. Highly recommend!

review_title: Wow! The Grand Canyon Skywalk Adventure Tour - West Rim
review_text: Wow! That’s all I could say each step of the way on this amazing Grand Canyon Skywalk Adventure Tour - West Rim! It was so fantastic! My boyfriend is the best for surprising me with this wonderful adventure while we were in Sedona!

When booking the trip Ellen was extremely helpful & the booking & prior arrangements were made with ease. We received a reminder email the day before. Upon arrival Ellen explained what would happen, where we would go & asked us if we suffered from any sickness, health issues etc,she was very helpful & accommodating. Our pilot was Josh & he was fantastic, he explained everything , there was constant conversation, answering all questions with ease & was very knowledgeable about the history & sights of Kauai.Drinks, mints & ginger were provided in the plane, as well as fans & headphones for all passengers who could communicate & ask questions at any time. The beauty of the island is amplified from the air & getting that aspect of the layout of the island early in our trip was helpful. The flight is very reasonably priced & was the highlight of our 10 day visit to the beautiful garden island!
Parents enjoyed the Kauai flying tour. Said it was one of their best trips to Hawaii. Wameia Canyon was breath taking! We do believe that this is far better than the Grand Canyon.
Great trip and tour guide.   I would recommend this tour to others.

Our ages ranged from 3 to 59 and we all enjoyed it! Kauai has magnificent scenery and this was an amazing way to see it and far less noisy than a helicopter! Captain Bruce was as knowledgeable as his website says and is an excellent pilot. He was engaging, humourous and our photos came out really well. Thank you, Wings over Kauai!

Kauai is incredible from the air!  Harry, our pilot, gave us a spectacular tour of The island. We went down Waimea canyon, wove through the Na'pali coast and circled back around many of the dozens of waterfalls we came upon. Our bonus round of aerobatics was especially fun and it gave us a taste of barnstorming that left us wanting more. Harry's knowledge of the island, including local hideaways and great hiking ideas added to our list of things to do here.  We enjoyed this tour more than the helicopter tour.

Best part of our Alaskan vacation,  our pilot was great, he told about the surroundings as we flew, landed on the glacier, we got out and walked around on the glacier-took photos-and then flew back.  One of the best memories we will ever have of Alaska

review_title: A check on the bucket list
review_text: Seeing the Grand Canyon from the air in a helicopter was absolutely amazing!  We were able to see so much and Daniel was a great pilot and tour guide.

Friday Harbor Seaplanes are awesome! The views up to Friday Harbor are breathtaking~and you experience this adventure in a famous de Havilland Single Propeller Seaplane. Landing by the rich & famous sailboats in the harbor! Walk out on the dock & enjoy kayaking & whale watching in an instant! The pilot gives a priceless narrative of flying thru these channels & up to Alaska for over thirty years! One of the most awesome experiences to take ~ real easy to video the ride!

We had a worderful 3+ hour flight to Port McNeill two Saturdays ago.  Check in was easy; pilot friendly (although he would not allow my daughter to join him in the cockpit due to weight and balance -- too bad).  Neverthess the flight, with two take offhand landings were exciting and amazing on a very clear day.  This is the best way to get to some remote parts of BC withoiut the hassle of ferries and cars.  There is a 25 lb limit on luggage which caused some stress and forcing me to leave some things I need behind.
Great classic planes, wonderful service.  Pilot Jim was great, and the scenery going to Zeballos was fantastic.  It was a great fishing trip, and the flights were a real highlight.

I met Brian at dinner on Thursday night. Started chatting and next thing you know I'm flying with Eric on Friday morning.  I'd never flown on a prop plane before. It was the smoothest most enjoyable flight I have ever been on. Spectacular views of Kauai and very friendly crew.
This is an experience that is not to be missed. The views, the photographic opportunities and the things you learn are things you will hold onto for a lifetime!

The flight over the downtown area, Alcatraz, and Treasure Island was a marvel.  And the sharp, descending left leading to a downwind landing gave us a feel for what real flying is like. I do hold a Private Pilot's License and was able to fly the Cessna 172 for the entire tour over almost the entire island of Kauai. Bruce is an excellent flight instructor, and gave me several pointers on improving my flying skills. The small plane tour will not get you into the canyons or valleys like a helicopter tour will, but if you are looking for a tour in a small plane, this is the operator to choose.

review_title: Miami Seaplane is the way to go!
review_text: To celebrate my 30th birthday, my girlfriend and I decided to head out to Bimini just for a quick getaway and taking a seaplane was by far the best choice we made. Our departure time was at noon and our pilot Tony had us in the air at exactly noon.  Even before the flight, Tony offered to take pictures of my girlfriend and I next to the plane just so we can have for memories which I thought was pretty cool.  The flight was actually smooth.  Honestly I was expecting a bumpy ride since it’s a small plane but it wasn’t.  During the flight we were taking pictures of ourselves with the ocean in the background. My girlfriend was ecstatic.  As we got closer to Bimini you could see the ocean color change to a light blue/greenish color.  It was really nice and making the seaplane trip even that much better.  When we got to Bimini, Tony flew us around the Island to point out different restaurants and local places that we could go to.  We even spotted sharks in the water so Tony brought the plane closer to the water so we could take videos and pictures.  The only thing that wasn’t pleasant was once we landed in Bimini we had to wait for Immigration and Customs officers to show up.  Even though Tony called them ahead of time and flew over their office to let them know that we’re about to land, they still took over a half hour to show up.  No fault of Tony’s of course.  After we cleared both Customs and Immigration, Tony called a local cab driver to pick us up and take us to the Hotel.  On the day of departures, again Tony was on time and ready to go but of course, we had to wait for Immigration and Customs again since they have to clear the plane coming from the U.S. and Tony as well.  But once in the air, we were back in Miami in no time.  I’m glad that we chose Miami Seaplane Tours as our transportation to Bimini.  It just made the trip that more special and something that I highly recommend to anyone.  IF YOU’RE GOING TO BIMINI, TAKE MIAMI SEAPLANE TOURS!!!!

review_title: Grand Canyon was Great, Scenic Airlines not so much...
review_text:
The Scenic Airlines Grand Canyon Connoisseur Tour is a great way to see the south rim of the Grand Canyon if you are visiting from Las Vegas.  A bus tour is the least expensive but makes for a very long day.  Of the 14 hours slated for a bus tour, 10 hours of it is spent driving back and forth. Only about 3 hours of the time is spent actually viewing the canyon.  Driving it yourself is also tedious unless you plan on staying overnight.  The helicopter tours also look great, but are almost twice the price.  So the Grand Canyon Connoisseur airplane tour was a good option.  One hour of flying there, then transfer by bus to tour the canyon for 3 hours, and then a one hour ride back.  They will also pick you up and drop you off from your Las Vegas hotel.  

However you decide to see the canyon, scour the internet for the best price and tour to suit your needs.  There’s a ton of choices and different prices for the same types of tours, so shop around.

Scenic, Papillion and Grand Canyon Airlines are all the same company, departing from the Boulder City airport, located about 45 minutes from the strip.  We found the best price for the tour with Scenic.  Grand Canyon Airlines has the exact same tour, but was slightly more.  There was also a difference in price, depending on what time of day you book your tour.  Our 9:15AM tour was the most expensive, the 12:30PM was less, and the 6:15AM was the least expensive.  

Here are a few tips:  When you book, give an accurate weight and even overestimate your weight a little.  They weigh you before you get on the plane, and that includes your purse, camera, water bottle, etc., so keep that in mind.  If you get motion sickness, take dramamine or bonine beforehand.  The plane is small (about 19 passengers), and it got quite bumpy for a good portion of the flight.  Do not pay extra for a window seat.  Our plane had two seats on each side and the windows are very large.  If you are a couple they generally seat you together, so one of you should get a window seat.

Now the GOOD:  
Beautiful aerial view of the Hoover Dam, Lake Mead, the Colorado River and the Grand Canyon.
Bus tour took you to Bright Angel and Mather Point. This is the most impressive and the widest and deepest part of the canyon.  Plenty of time to souvenir shop too.
Gigi, our bus driver was fabulous!  She was a lot of fun and gave a  lot of interesting information.  They also had another guide to speak Japanese for part of our group.

And the BAD:
Our tour was scheduled to leave at 9:15am. The Boulder Terminal was very hectic, and had several groups all leaving around the same time for different plane and helicopter tours.  They “color coded” each group to make things simple.  Each of the groups were called, except for our “purple” group.  We were left sitting there well past the 9:15 departure time.   We went up and asked after it was a half hour late and was told they were waiting for the pilot.  20 more minutes went by and someone else asked the desk and was not given any more information.  When the pilot finally showed up he told our group that the audio portion of the tour wasn’t working and they were trying to fix it.  We finally started toward the gate a full HOUR past our original departure time.  No one told us we would be delayed, and were still not sure what the real problem was.  They just let us sit there and didn’t say a word.  We’ve been on several tours including helicopter tours so we know the general routine.  In our opinion, it was very unprofessional of Scenic not to inform us of a major delay.  When the pilot finally showed up he acted like nothing happened.  Everyone was fuming.  

We ended up having a great tour in spite of the bad start, but we really feel Scenic should review this incident and handle it more professionally in the future.

I've been on helicoptors over and outside of Vegas, rode dune buggies in the desert outside of Vegas, an airboat in the Everglades, a catamaran, submarie and a 10 person plane in Hawaii, parasailed in the Bahamas and on and on, but honestly the seaplane was one of the coolest experiences ever bringing together water and sky. review_title: Absolutely the very best part of our Alaska trip!
review_text: You absolutely cannot visit Alaska and Denali National Park without taking a flightseeing tour -- and K2 is the BEST, bar none.  We talked to many others in the area and everyone raves about them because they specialize in the tour experience, not just ferrying climbers (though they are popular for doing that too).  The pilot who gave our tour was not only a skilled aviator but also extremely knowledgeable about the history and science of the area, telling great stories and pointing out fascinating points of interest through the pilot headsets we all wore. Takeoff and landing was smooth and we never felt nervous or airsick at all -- such a lovely flight!  The office staff was so friendly and helpful, and extremely flexible if you need to reschedule your tour due to weather as we did -- we found out that the summit of Mt. McKinley is only visible 30% of the time due to weather, but they are great about offering other options or rescheduling your flight, etc. And the aircraft is gorgeous, spotlessly maintained and comfortable. Even if you don't see the summit there is SO MUCH incredible stuff to see in the park on your flight.  There are things we saw on this tour that very few people will ever see and that will take your breath away -- 35-mile-long glaciers, sheer cliff amphitheaters, passes so dramatic it feels like your wingtips will scrape the sides (they're not even close, but it feels that way!), the Great Gorge that's deeper than the Grand Canyon, glacial pools that are literally Windex blue, ice crevasses and ice falls, on and on.  Of course if the weather is nice as it was for us, you'll see Mt McKinley (Denali), the highest summit in North America and and the rest of the range (Foraker-Denali's Wife and Hunter-Denali's child) and probably ask yourself who would be crazy enough to climb those things (a thousand try every spring, and less than half make it!).  Even my teenage kids were speechless and taking photos nonstop -- if you're a photographer you better bring an extra memory card!  And the optional glacier landing is a MUST -- we will never forget landing on skis and walking around on an actual glacier in the shadow of the most dramatic mountain scenery anywhere.  This is a trip of just a few hours that we will NEVER, never forget. Worth every penny and more!
