We have taken helicopter tours in other places, loved it, and when we saw this biplane we thought it would be better. Glad we did it, but we will be going back to the helicopters in the future. This is great for average to smaller size people.
Pilot was great, plane was shiny and new, service and booking experience was excellent. We thought the pictures would be better since there is no window, but the wing is in almost every shot. Also, my husband is a big, broad shouldered man (size XXL shirt) and we technically fit, but definitely not comfortably. 
Again, the plane and service was excellent, we have no complaints. Just not our “size”

review_title: Amazing Experience, do not miss out!!
review_text: My husband and I took the Cessna tour for two with Bruce and it was the highlight of our visit to Kauai! We took a helicopter tour when we visited the Big Island four years ago which was a little rough, so we opted to try a plane and are so glad we did! Bruce was a wonderful pilot and tour guide and we loved the family atmosphere that Bruce and his family created. We saw amazing scenery throughout our hour long flight and definitely felt like we got the better end of the deal there! If you're debating between a helicopter tour and Wings over Kauai, choose the plane, you won't regret it!!

Great ,great , great , I loved it soooooooo much I would like to do it again ,again and again.
 As you can only access 20% of Kauai by road its a must to fly  to see all the beauty of this island , specially with Wings were you have the best views in the cockpit and best service . 
Thanks to Ellen ,Sophia , Josh and Bruce for making me very comfortable and sharing all they know about  the island

We did a combined trip of aeroplane flight, jeep tour and rafting. Friendly pilot and amazing views on flight.Great walk through antelope canyon and the rafting was fantastic.Rafting is a great way to see the canyon.Highly recommend

We flew with Will from K2 Aviation, and it was an awesome experience! Even though we weren’t able to safely land on the glacier, we still got to see a lot of amazing landscapes, including Mt. Denali! 
I would highly recommend this to everyone!

Overall a good trip and worth the money.  the narration was hard to hear above the noise of the plane and the plane is cramped but it is a small plane and you have great visibility from all seats.  Touring by plane does not get you down and close up with waterfalls like touring by helicopter does but the plane gets you higher and gives you a better overall view.

review_title: One of the most amazing days of my life
review_text: I am an outdoors, adventure and travel journalist and I have seen some amazing places and enjoyed the most fantastic trips but this day will be a highlight for a very long time. The trip was very well organised and professional. What we saw in just one day including the small plane ride, helicopter trip, boat trip and Skywalk was absolutely ideal. I would have loved to stay for longer at the Grand Canyon but my schedule did not allow for this. I highly recommend this company and this trip. You can see further details on my blog Fiona Outdoors .co . uk

I spent alot of time reviewing different ways to see Kauai by air and Im glad I went with Wings Over Kauai.  Bruce and Ellen make you feel right at home.  The flight itself is fantastic - amazing views and alot of Island knowledge from Bruce.  I highly recommend Wings of Kauai!

I went with my grown daughter (no appropriate option above to choose from) to do the west grand canyon, sky walk 7.5 hour experience. This operation is 5* from beginning to end. Our trip was confirmed the day before. As instructed, we met Chick (in a white Nissan) outside our hotel lobby and were taken to the airfield where we met our pilot Chris. My daughter and I were the only passengers today.  Chris informed us that the grand canyon tour catered to the Asians and not to think him rude if he "bullied" his way through the throngs of people. We were informed that busloads of Asians are brought here daily from Las Vegas and that they push and do not understand the concept of waiting in line. True to his word, the place was mostly Asian (95+%) all pushing and moving in herds. It was so bad, that trying to exit the stall in the bathroom was almost impossible! Once outside of the restroom, Chris and another pilot arranged for the 2 groups to go ahead of the masses. We did our helicopter ride and pontoon boat down the Colorado river, then another helicopter ride back to the starting point. From there, we met up with Chris who whisked us off to a bus to do the skywalk. Very impressive, but expect long lines. Afterwards, we went to Guano Point for lunch. Be prepared to wait in line and be pushed and jostled. The food, I must admit, was poor at best- overcooked beans, corn, and then either pulled pork or bland chicken. There was also Cole slaw, mashed potatoes, a roll and chocolate cake, plus a bottle of water. My advice, pass on lunch or better yet, bring your own. I realize I went to see the sights and they were great... Lunch is just part of the package. After lunch, Chris took us on a hike and showed us the remains of the guano mining and lots of neat trivia. After this, back on the bus to a gift shop ( what else) and then back to the plane for the 1.5 hour return flight. This is a class operation and the experience would not have been as wonderful without a caring, knowledgeable pilot/ guide. I highly recommend this trip.

Makana was wonderful. 
 He was very informative and funny throughout the flight.  Took his time to show everyone on each side of the aircraft the all sights.
He definitely puts the customer service first and made sure we had a great day.  Cant wait to do it again soon and hopefully have Makana as out pilot again

review_title: Denali Flying Tour with K2 Aviation
review_text:
Since we didn't see much at the Denali National Park bus tour, we decided to do the flying tour as we were staying in Talkeetna. Let me tell if you haven't done this don't miss the opportunity to do this it is one of the wonders of the world. The sheer beauty and awe inspiring nature so overpowering to see from air which you wouldn't get from walking or hiking. The magnitude of the size of glaciers and the mountains were just incredible. 
The K2 pilot was very knowledgeable and the service was great. Don't miss this opportunity if you can afford it will cost around 240/- USD pp without lading.

The views were spectacular! We saw delicate arch, needles, and zoomed over Canyonlands. The views were breathtaking! Our ride was a bit bumpy which caused me to get a little dizzy, but it the weather made the views just so much more spectacular! Some of the mountains looked like they were smoking!

Completely worth the cost--everything about our 45 minute flight over the Grand Canyon was amazing. There isn't a bad seat in the plane--I think it was a 15-seater. The windows are large so you can see everything even if you are in the middle of three seats. We went all the way up to North Rim which was great since we weren't planning to travel there by car. A wonderful flight!

We took the Classic Misty Fjords Flightseeing Tour in August 2016. We were planning on taking a longer tour with a different tour company, but we wanted to use our on-board cruise credit so we booked with Taquan Air. The tour was two hours and the perfect amount of time to get some great views of the fjords.

I forgot our pilot's name, which is unfortunate because he was very knowledgable on the area and funny as well. The planes are pretty old, but well maintained and, according to our pilot, very reliable.

You set out over the cruise ships and Ketchikan towards the fjords. It takes about 20-30 minutes to get into the national park and the views are spectacular. We ended up landing on the water in the middle of the fjords and were able to get out onto the side of the plane to look around and take pictures. It's unbelievably beautiful and serene once you are on the water.

We expected more wildlife on the tour, but only saw a bunch of seals lying on a beach from a long distance. We asked our tour guide and he said that there are very rarely wildlife spottings on this tour. The tour is amazing nonetheless, but that's just an expectation to having going into the tour.

We had an amazing time and would highly recommend.

review_title: Cancelled tour. No courtesy call from company ahead to inform
review_text: Didn’t inform me about tour cancellation until I drove 2.5 hrs from Anchorage to reach there.Still awaiting refund

review_title: To Say The Least, It Was The Most!
review_text: My nephew and I went up with pilot Harry and from take off to landing the experience was great.  Harry did a great job informing all six of us on our tour of many main attractions that are available to undergo while on the ground as well as historical facts about the island paradise.  Parts of the ride was a little bumpy, but we were forewarned before takeoff.  Seeing the island from an aerial perspective is a fantastic  way to go!
Awe inspiring, seeing the majesty of all that is beautiful in the world. Our pilot was interesting and highly competent too!

This was my first helicopter ride and my first time seeing the Grand Canyon. I can’t imagine a better way to do it. So incredible!! Our pilot was super informative and friendly and we had a smooth, safe ride!

review_title: MUCH BETTER THAN A HELICOPTER TOUR!
review_text:
Initially we were looking to do a helicopter tour as we had done one before, but decided on the plane because of the cost and duration. We weren't disappointed!

It seems like these tours are truly a labor of love for Eric (Pilot) as this was far and above, the most memorable experience of our trip thus far. 

The views and Eric's knowledge of the island were second to none. I would recommend Eric and Maui Plane Rides to ANYONE, and EVERYONE. 

Skip the helicopter tour and do this instead, you'll be glad you did!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text:
Two major things you need to have a great flight seeing experience a good pilot and fantastic weather, we were fortunate to have both. 

The plane ride out to see Denali was smooth and the pilot was great making sure everyone was able to see the awesome sights in front and below us. The clouds cleared from the great mountain just as we got close which I guess makes us part of the 30% crowd that saw the mountain. 

He then took us through some valleys and we saw glaciers and some of the wonderful jewel like reflections of deep blue peaking through the snow. We did hit a bit of turbulence in one of the passes and the pilot handled it beautifully.

It was an awe inspiring experience and I'm so glad to call Alaska home.

Great overview of where we live and work all at 1200 ft !!!!
 Real fun on a seaplane.....a new adventure!!

We couldn't do the glacier landing due to the weather, so our pilot, Chris, decided showed us the spots that were well visible. Chris also told us a lot about the area and was it was an extremely smooth flight for such a small plane (10 people including pilot). All in all, a great experience even though not as planned and everything went very smooth and easy with K2, all very professional and super friendly.
What a fabulous experience.  My 17-year old son & I enjoyed our flight.  The staff was professional and our pilot was awesome.  We were in good hands while having the experience of a lifetime.

Awe inspiring flight around Mt McKinley and landing on one of it's glaciers.  I've been to some beautiful places but I teared up on this one and thought of my dad who so loved the mountains.

John is a cautious - the kind of guy you want piloting a single engine

Originally when I was looking to book an air tour, I was unable to find a company that would take small children. I have a 2 1/2 year old who travels well and who I prefer to bring along with me whenever possible. Fortunately, Wings Over Kauai was referenced on a TripAdvisor forum, and when I followed up to confirm that they take small children, I was assured that they have lots of experience with kids, provide a booster cushion to help kids see out the windows, and provide a kid-size headset! 

Val, the office manager, and Cameron, the pilot, were both incredibly professional and friendly with us. They made us feel welcome and at ease, and got us settled onto the Cessna with no hiccups. The flight was amazing! Totally worth doing, and a definite highlight of our trip. My 2 1/2 year old enjoyed wearing her headset and looking out of her window for about half the flight, and then had a nap for the rest of the flight. 

I would recommend Wings over Kauai for any group. The Cessna is amazing because you get the plane to yourself if you only have a couple and maybe a child. I’m sure the larger plane is great for bigger groups, but I didn’t experience it. Hands down, take this tour!

We flew with Harry in the 182. Personal service at a group rate price. Harry was an excellent pilot and did a great job getting into and out of the mountains with low clouds surrounding some of the sites we were to see. His knowledge of the sites and the associated weather made us feel safe and we got tons of pictures. I am a pilot alos and this team is great. Kevin, Kacee and harry took great care to see our adventure was the best part of our trip to the 50 th state.

We walked up on the Fourth of July and my husband spontaneously booked tickets for everyone in our family - there are six of us! It was glorious seeing the mountain up close. We did the short tour, not knowing how the boys would fare, ages 8,6,4 and 1. My 8-year-old still talks about seeing the Moose's Tooth and the Sheldon Amphitheater was priceless for me to see. We'd do it again and take the longer tour all the way around Denali and/or get dropped off and go hike around. It is spectacular! Just remembering the images of those mountains is PRICELESS!
One note about the baby: K2 provided a Britax car seat for him to sit in along with sound-canceling ear muffs. They were so accommodating for our crew! The pilot was super friendly and answered all the questions little people can ask. We'd do this again in a heartbeat and take the kids along - it was that great of an experience.

This was a great day. The pilot did an awesome job after we hit severe turbulence over the Grand Canyon. The ground tour was great as well and in spite of less than perfect weather, we saw great beauty and had great fun. Even the optional box lunch was very good. I’d highly recommend this tour.

review_text: We did the sunset tour.  IF YOU GO TO MAUI, YOU SHOULD ABSOLUTELY DO THIS TOUR!  You will see a side of Maui that most people don't get to see!  Maui on land is amazing, but Maui from the sky is ABSOLUTELY STUNNING!  Please do this tour!  You will not regret it!

Quickly took off and followed the coast for a while. Lovely scenery really captured the beauty of the island. Doug was very informative on the history of the area. We did attempt go into the valley but the weather was against us and we were buffeted a bit. Which was hair raising. Doug turned towards the coast and followed the land. Beautiful island.  Clothing for the trip was casual. After the trip we were given a photo and cd of the music that was playing in the background.  well worth the trip and thanks for making us feel so welcome

This was an amazing experience! Erik was very informative, explaining the beautiful views. Steve made me feel safe as he was flying. I would recommend this tour to any and everyone visiting Maui. Aloha!

From beginning to end, working with the individuals who own one operate Wings over Kauai was a first class experience.  They went out of their way to make sure we received the tour we needed/wanted and that tour was one of the best we've experienced. On top of everything else, they keep the price reasonable!  Thank you Ellen and Josh and all of those at Wings over Kauai for a day we will never forget!

Realmente una experiencia inolvidable. Bien la atención de la empresa al llegar. No entiendo la necesidad de re confirmación si ya esta pago. Es un trastorno porque no admite mail. El piloto amable pero estaba con el teléfono mensajeando todo el tiempo en el vuelo, y no era capaz de indicarle a las personas que no se sentían bien que activaran mayor cantidad de aire. En términos generales recomendaría la experiencia.Las vistas son impresionantes y cuesta menos que el helicóptero.

review_text: We took my son on an incredible adventure!! Sergio our pilot was awesome and very knowledgeable about the area and sites. The trip went by so quickly!!! Could have stayed up there for hours!! Thanks, Sergio!!!
Seeing the sea cliffs from the air was awesome! Also saw dolphins jumping near Molokini crater. Definitely recommend!

review_text: Stunning way to see the island!  So glad we did it by airplane. Josh explained what we were seeing and even pointed out whales off the cost!
Wonderful flight, Beautiful views, worth every penny could not be any happier with the flight loved, loved it so much was a bucket list checked off, thank you so much!

We took the air tour of Misty Fjords since I was told this was the only way to see it.  It was a nice flight and we landed on the water and took off again.  I'm not sure that I would do it again.  It was expensive and we did other things on our trip to Alaska that we loved.  Our pilot didn't really say much, pointed out some locations but I would have liked to have heard some actual history, facts.  There was a boat tour that looked nice but I'm not sure if we had the time to go out on a boat.
I can't add much to what has already been said.  Bruce and his family are great.  I saw a whale from the plane, and we both appreciated the safety the plane provides.

review_title: Great Way to See Kauai from the Air
review_text:
Prior to arriving in Kauai, my wife and I decided to take an aerial tour of Kauai. After researching various companies, both fixed wing and helicopter, we decided to fly with Wings Over Kauai, and this tour was absolutely spectacular!
After checking in with Val, and going over the safety instructions, we were introduced to our pilot Marcus. He is thoroughly professional, but his professionalism is balanced out with a friendly and warm personality.
Once we were in the air, he conversed with us throughout the entire tour, and pointed out landmarks along the way. This is a great way to see the Island from up above, and it is a beauty to behold!
My wife and I highly recommend Marcus, and Wings Over Kauai!

review_title: A Most Amazing Experience - Flight and Glacier Landing
review_text:
I booked a flightseeing trip with the Talkeetna Air Taxi through the Alaska Railroad reservation services in mid-April. It was the most wonderful experience! I had checked the 7-day weather forecast and saw that the weather on that Saturday would be perfect, no cloud cover. The TAT provides complimentary hotel pick-up, and a very nice young gentleman picked me up, along with others I had met on the train who were staying at another hotel.

We arrived at the TAT office at the flightline, and we all lined up to be weighed and outfitted with shoe covers for those without snowboots. I looked around and noted that Adam Richman (of Man vs. Food fame) had been a celebrity customer. He had left an autographed photo for the TAT staff to hang on their wall.

The flight started out with a safety briefing and we all boarded with great anticipation. The airplane was a De Havilland Canada DHC-3 Otter. We were provided headphones to listen to the flightseeing narrative by the pilot. It wasn't until I returned home to discover the call-sign "Zero Papa Romeo" referred to the last three letters/numbers on the aircraft (0PR). 

We flew around the peaks of Denali, and then for the highlight, landed very smoothly on the Sheldon Amphitheater on Ruth Glacier. It was so nice chatting with the other passengers all in excitement of what we were experiencing. We hopped out and started snapping photos of each other, of the terrain, of the Sheldon Mountain House (and yes, the outhouse with a lady exiting). When someone asked the pilot which peak was Denali, he pointed up to a peak way up high and so tiny above us and to the left. It was difficult to fathom exactly how high Denali actually was. The takeoff was amazing! It was as if we were in a helicopter! It took very little distance to lift off of the glacier snow. It was explained the turboprop made all the difference compared to the days of the old Cessna planes.

I cannot do any more than to recommend that this should be added to everyone's "bucket list." It was so wonderful!

If your visiting the San Francisco Area this tour is an experience you should not miss.  I live in the area and love to take visiting friends for the tour or take someone up for a special birthday.  

Fred was our pilot with 32 years old experience flying, also he gave a knowledgeable overview of the history of the sites as we flew over them.  We flew over the Golden Gate Bridge, the Richmond-San Rafael Bridge and the Oakland Bay Bridge, the view was stunning.  Also, we flew over San Francisco’s famous skyscrapers, Mount Tamalpais, Angel Island, Alcatraz, and along the coastal towns by the Pacific ocean.

review_title: Fantastic Trip, Ready to Book Again!
review_text: I had a fantastic view of Denali and all her glory with Pilot Chris.  The views of Denali National Park were absolutely incredible.  Our pilot Chris provided a VERY smooth ride, from takeoff to landing and everything in between.  The booking and check-in process was smooth and easy.  I am ready to visit again in the summer so I can compare the views.

We recently visited Ketchikan and opted for a floatplane excursion with Seawind Aviation. It was the best decision of our entire trip. Lesley met us as we got off our ship and took us to meet Rick  who they recommended for a bit of salmon fishing before our 11am flight. It was great. Rick took us out on his recently repowered boat and proceeded to take us where the salmon were to be found. He also handled taking our fish for processing and shipping. You couldn't ask for more as Rick told us about the history of Ketchikan and many important aspects of daily life there. 
We arrived for our flight right on time and met up with Steve, Lesley's husband. We were off for my wife's first flight in a smaller plane. She loved it. There were great photo op's with whales and bears not in short supply. The scenery was second to none with Steve providing us a very safe and exciting trip. My wife couldn't stop smiling. 
Forget the cruise line overpriced tours and contact Steve and Lesley. You won't regret the decision.

Ray and Carol    May 20, 2012
This is a great air tour to see the different sights of Kauai.  Our pilot Harry was great.  The island is absolutely beautiful.
We had the most amazing flight in the helicopter.  It was a unique experience and is highly recommended it.  Well run, friendly and a must do for any tourist

review_title: An amazing once in a lifetime experience! Highly recommend!
review_text: Our air tour to Sedona and the Grand Canyon was everything they said it would be and more! Best money I ever spent and I would do it again! Absolutely fantastic from beginning to end. Meg at Westwind Air Service handled our reservations and was professional, kind and answered my many questions. We were met with an enthusiastic staff who treated us better than family, making sure we had an "over the top" experience. Sights from the air and breathtaking and cannot be experienced any other way. I highly recommend the ground tour package as well. It was a memory making fun filled day that did not even feel rushed. The pink jeep tour and guide was awesome and provided many unique detailed facts that kept us wanting more. We left from Phoenix in the morning and returned in the early afternoon having experienced two natural wonders in a unique, fantastic and beautiful way. Trust me when I say, it is a once in a lifetime experience everyone should take!

We flew on Wings over Kauai today with three other guests and Josh as our pilot.  The weather was good - not too many clouds between us and unique views of paradise.  Josh was an excellent pilot and guide to the fabulous scenery - pointing out flora, fauna, points of interest, geological facts, many waterfalls, and historical facts.  We saw humpback whales, monk seals, large crashing waves on the north shore, Tow surfers, and glorious views of Mt. Wai'ale'ale.  Flightseeing is a wonderful way to see the beauty of this mostly pristine island (while providing an aerial view of other highlights).  Brilliant!

De Misty fjords sightseeing tour met Taquan Air is echt een aanrader, het personeel is vriendelijk, behulpzaam en goed op de hoogte van alle lokale highlights. Het vliegtuig was een echte klassieker wat het helemaal afmaakte.
We have never experienced anything like this before.  Highly recommend it to anyone.  A must do when someone visits Alaska.

review_title: Trust the reviews... it is AWESOME!
review_text:
We used WOK after reading all the reviews from tripadvisor and we couldn't have been more pleased. This is a fantastic experience and the staff were all wonderful. From the organising to the flight everything went perfectly.

This is a must and was a highlight for everyone including my Dad who has seen the world and it takes a fair bit to impress him. The flight is stunning and really completes a trip to Kauai. Worth every cent!

Bruce was extremely informative and a wonderful pilot - a pilot with a Ph.D makes for a great flight! Not much more to be said that hasn't already been said however if you suffer from motion sickness I would recommend taking something beforehand (mainly due to the fact it is a light plane - not to any fault of the pilot).

They even gave us a lift to the airport after! A wonderful family run business that really delivers!

review_title: Got a great overview of the Garden Island
review_text: Just got back from our timeshare vacation on Kauai. Had never done the helicopter thing and wasn't real anxious to be in one either but we love Kauai and had done the cat sunset tour of Napali coast and seen it from the outlooks at Kokee. When I heard about the plane ride I knew it was for me. It was smooth, slow and very relaxing and I felt very safe. It was a wonderfully clear day and not much of the trade winds to be found. Since I was alone I got the co-pilot seat but I think any seat would be good as the windows are BIG and the noise low. Another added value was that it's eco-friendly and I appreciate that. I had a great hour taking pictures and videos of my fantasy island that I can relive any time I want.

This trip was one of the best things we have ever done!!
Helicopter was huge. It’s climate controlled , big comfy seat (5 people and pilot). You wear nice  headphone w/mic to talk to pilot. Also awesome music is piped in .  So very 😎 cool.  I couldn’t possibly describe the Grand Canyon or how awesome it was   It is definitely a must-see if it’s not on your bucket list it needs to be   Well worth the price

I'd like to start with the fact that each and every member of the staff was professional, nice and very knowledgeable.  They were unsure of the ability to do this tour as advertised due to weather conditions in the area, but instead of changing the route or even cancelling they decided to go up and see how things looked and it turned out that we were able to not only get to the mountains we went a little further to make the experience even more amazing.  i would highly recommend checking them out! i am definitely planning to head back in the future and will try another experience.

We loved our flight. We had bright sun and clear skies on top but clouds at the landing zone and were unable to land, it didn't matter it was still beautiful. Our pilot was knowledgeable and everyone at Talkeetna Air Taxi was friendly and helpful.
We were treated to a fantastic mornng tour! Our pilot Justin(JT)  and crew Thomas were professional and efficient. Lots of fun. We would def do it again!

We've done both helicopter and now, airplane tours on Kauai. While helicopter gets closer and is definitely more of a heart racing experience, I found this plane tour offered a more relaxing experience while giving great view of all the highlights at a fraction of the cost of a heli tour. The tour guide had tons of great info as well and on the heli tour it's much harder to hear and learn. If your goal is seeing all the island has to offer with budget in mind, I highly recommend this!

This was an absolutely fantastic experience and I would highly recommend it! The pilot was so nice, accommodating and did anything and everything possible to ensure we were comfortable and had a great experience. Thank you Maui Plane Rides for making our anniversary so special and memorable!

WOW! Today, my daughter and I took a flight to see CanyonLands and the Arches. Our pilot, Craig, was PHENOMENAL! NOT ONLY was he charming, he was incredibly knowledgeable about all aspects of the parks and sights. Our 1.5 hours was BY FAR the highlight of the week! HIGHLY RECOMMEND the entire RedTail Aviation team and ESPECIALLY CRAIG !!!
Great trip - our pilot, Eric made the entire journey very enjoyable and safe. Best scenes/views in Maui!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: I had a great time flying Denali with TAT; the flight was smooth and comfortable, the pilot (Richard) was experienced, friendly, and knowledgeable, and the views were jaw-dropping. If you're on the fence about the glacier landing, I'd recommend going for it; it definitely enhanced the experience by giving us some time to absorb the views, and the landing and takeoff were straightforward and smooth, on a large snow-field.
The pilot was super friendly and knowledgeable and fun to fly with. The flight was amazing. The pictures are priceless The experience definitely worth it! We'll be back.

review_title: Absolutely breathtaking! Weather was amazing for us!
review_text: The flight was on a perfect day, with slight breeze, clouds at 2600' and it was smooth sailing at 2500'! What a beautiful flight with amazing scenes! A must do on Kauai!

review_title: Flight and glacier landing by Denali
review_text: Beautiful trip. Fantastic views. Super pilot, he was friendly and knowledgeable about the area. Worth every penny.

Though it was touch and go whether or not we would be able to complete a flight tour, it was well worth the wait. We were initially scheduled to fly on Saturday, but for weather reasons, the flights were grounded. Luckily we had hotel reservations for the night so we could reschedule for Sunday. We opted to do the glacier landing, and this was a huge hit with our kids. If doing a flight-tour is a must on your trip, then I suggest you book a night in Talkeetna. That way if your flight is cancelled, you have another shot at flying the next day. The staff was great in accommodating us the next day. And, Talkeetna is a fun, quirky town to spend the night in. Last caveat for families with young kids - our teen loved the whole experience, but our 8 year old fell asleep on the way back.

We took a flight over Misty Fjords as a cruise ship excursion.  The scenery is incredibly beautiful. Our pilot was great, and his commentary over the headphones was very informative. The landing on a lake was smooth, and the quietness of the surroundings added to the majesty.
A couple of notes to be aware of, especially if you have kids: the plane gets pretty cramped, and so it gets stuffy prior to takeoff. And because it's a small plane, expect a few dips and drops as the plane hits pockets of cooler or warmer air. Prepare your kids, if they've never been in a smaller plane.

review_title: A great way to see Kaua'i
review_text:
Yes, there are helicopter rides. Good, I have no doubt, but this is a great trip.
From the young people who check you in to knowledgeable pilots (Paul, in this case).
It an hour of great fun and even better views. /you will not be disappointed.
Sights from the coasts to the NaPali Cliffs, to the North Shore at Hanalei and Princeville, to
the island's interior with stunning waterfalls.
You'll see way more that you can from the car....
Do yourself a favour and travel with Air Ventures.
They even do combo flights with luau or boat rides, if you are interested.
Enjoy.

This was a Holland America Cruise Line shore excursion. A great experience all the way around: weather, sights, and dining. Our ground crew and pilot for Taquan Air were friendly, organized, and competent. Even if you're a tad nervous about flying in a small ( 6 Pax) float plane, you will soon be absorbed by the majesty of Alaska and will not feel unsafe. The crab dinner at the George Inlet Lodge exceeded expectations and redefined all you can eat. Our gracious hostess provided a short "how to" demo on how to eat a crab. She was friendly, knowledgeable, and most important, kept the crab coming! One note, we were the last tour of the day and to meet our cruise departure we felt a bit rushed toward the end of our dinner. If possible book an earlier tour.

The best part of our whole trip! Must get Matt as your pilot. He was an amazing pilot with an amazing personality. The ride was smooth and he was full of knowledge. Took us to beautiful places. I was with my 76 yr old dad and 8 yr old daughter. They had the best time. My 8 yr old keeps talking about her experience and how she wants to do it again. I feel the same way!!

We had an all-around amazing trip to Alaska, but this flight was a highlight for our whole family.  My husband and I flew with our 9-year-old daughter as part of a small glacier-landing group.  The scenery was astonishing and our pilot was a true pro.  We had fun playing in the snow on an 80-degree day and got some of the best pictures of our trip to share and remember when we got back home.  The entire staff, in the air and on the ground, were great and we really enjoyed our experience.

review_title: Grand Canyon south rim or west rim?
review_text: On a recent trip to Las Vegas, our trip to the Grand Canyon was a must do! I did a bit of research and decided that the south rim was the ideal. Maverick had a trip that involved a short plane flight to the Grand Canyon airport where we were met by an outstanding bus driver Michael, who took us up through the national park to the lodges. This is where we were supplied a basket lunch and was able to walk along the path to the various scenic lookouts. The bus then took us back to airport and we boarded the helicopter which was piloted by Dan and we flew around the south rim and through the canyon for about 20 mins. Back to airport and on the plane bound for Las Vegas. Absolutely fantastic experience that was made more special by the 4 inches of snow that had fallen the day before we went. The staff at maverick were so professional, courteous and helpful that only made the trip more special.  Not cheap ( with the Aussie dollar convertion)  but Definitely worth every cent. Of course we were lucky to go since the two days prior had been cancelled because of the snow/weather, so maybe suggest that you book early in your stay so that if it is cancelled then there is the chance that you can go another day.

review_title: Do it!  Grand Denali Tour was incredible!
review_text: Our pilot Chris said we had one of the best days he'd ever seen to experience the Grand Denali Tour.  Simply stunning views, flew through all sorts of incredible spaces and the glacier landing was a once in a lifetime experience.  On the way back, Chris let my 5 year old be the co-pilot, which he LOVED.  Not inexpensive but totally, totally worth it.

Kauai is beautiful from the air, and some kind of flight tour is well worth it. Wings Over Kauai was a comfortable, friendly way to see Kauai from the air. Everyone had the aloha spirit, the pilot was knowledgeable and informative without being intrusive, and the tour lasted just the right amount of time.
Dennis was an excellent pilot and guide. The tour was well planned and on time. You can't get as deep in the canyon as you could with a helicopter,  but the over fly Vistas were specular.

review_title: Great Cessna air tour with Bruce
review_text: We booked a private tour in a Cessna with Wings Over Kauai.  We got an hour long tour of the beautiful island with Bruce....just my wife and I and the pilot.  The views were stunning and Bruce is very knowledgeable.  We chose the air tour due to the longer flight time and comfort with a plane (with wings!) rather than a helicopter.  My wife gets a little motion sick and had no issues.

review_title: Just Amazing you have to do it
review_text: Its was just Amazing. Flying over Mt Denali and Landing on a Glacier. You get out and play in the snow. You have to do it. It was worth the money. Just do it

We were lucky to have a sunny, clear morning for this experience and we loved it.  The pilot was very knowledgeable and the views were great.  If you have time do this when you are in San Francisco and then spend some time in Sausalito which is well worth a visit.

Fantastic!!!
We decided to NOT go to Antelope Canyon but go on this flight instead. We saw the crowds at Antelope from above and knew we made the right decision.
Pilot Ben flew us over Lake Powell and Rainbow Bridge and loved every minute of it.
What a fantastic experience. So glad we did this.

Wir haben mit GC Scenic Airlines einen Rundflug von 45 Min über den GC gemacht. Tolles Erlebnis den GC mal aus der Luft zu sehen und zu überfliegen. Beim nächsten Mal würden wir aber einen Heli vorziehen, weil der tiefer in den Canyon reinfliegt.

This is a fantastic way to see the immensity of the Misty Fjords area. There is no way a land-based trip can give you the scope of the area that a small plane can, and SeaWind was a perfect company for my small family of three to go with to see the scenery. From pick-up to return, the entire process is very professional and friendly, with a true family feel to the experience. There were five people in our little sea plane, not counting the pilot, and we all had great views as all seats are alongside a window. We took off from the same harbor where our cruise ship was docked, and we flew over forests, mountains, lakes, waterfalls, and rivers. While we were in a plane, it was still easy for the pilot to get close to the areas he wanted us to see. For example, he circled around a waterfall a few times so we could all get a good view, and since the plane was so small and relatively slow moving, we all got up close and personal. It was amazing to see such pristine wilderness from the perfect vantage points. We took a ton of pictures out of the windows, and they looked really good. It's a great way to capture the sights.

Rolf, our pilot, gave us expert commentary as we went along, and he really knows his stuff after spending decades in the area. I was sitting in the front passenger seat, and he showed me the radar, communication equipment, and other cool cockpit stuff. It was really cool.

We landed on a beautiful lake for a short photo stop. I'm sure one of the pictures Rolf took of us will make it to our Christmas card this year. It was a gorgeous location and was about as peaceful as can be. Then we got back in the plane for the second half of the flight, which was as beautiful as the first. Rolf took us a different way back, which was great. We loved every minute of it.

The trip isn't cheap, but if you're in Ketchikan, do yourself a favor and splurge on a trip like this. If you do, go with SeaWind. They are great people who will give you a once-in-a-lifetime experience. You won't regret it for a minute.

Our shuttle driver was AJ he was great, our pilot Mike was awesome showed us so many things high low close and farther away he made our trip so great, Leslie in the office was so easy to deal with, got off the boat walked to tourist center man in the center called into the office for me, we shopped for a little bit, Leslie called us said AJ was coming then things went on from there so very easy and wonderful thanks guys

review_title: Float plane to black bears tour
review_text: Fantastic pilots, planes and the guide to the bears was great! Highly recommend this company and tour. Book early, limited number of people can go per day.

review_title: Eine tolle Tour, die ich auf jeden Fall empfehlen kann. Unkompliziert, fairer Preis und hat meine Erwartungen übertroffen.
review_text: Eine tolle Tour die meine Erwartungen übertroffen hat. Sehr unkompliziert, fairer Preis, nettes Personal, alles top.
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_text: First rate operation! Safety is number 1 but is closely followed by making sure you have a great experience. We were fortunate to have "Perfect" weather the day of our trip. We were scheduled to go at 9:00 am with a glacier landing included but with clear sky's and very cold temps on the mountain they called early saying the glacier froze to hard for a landing. We went at 11:00 am instead. They were very accommodating and the sky's were clear and the glacier softened up so we landed. Unbelievable experience and views that only 30% of visitors see. Along with me was my wife and two friends. This was more than an activity, it was phenomenal! Spend the money, you won't regret it.

No words or pictures can summarize just how amazing this experience was! If your visiting Alaska and looking for things to see/do don't hesitate on this one because of the price. This is an absolute must do and worth every penny!
It’s really the only way to see the GC! Our pilot was so nice, safe and informative. It’s worth every penny. Do the 45 min tour so you can see most of the canyon.

review_title: Flight to land on glacier at Denali National Park
review_text:
Although rather expensive, it was the most memorable and beautiful experience ever.  They even let me borrow a jacket for the 17 degree temp on the glacier.
It is so beautiful flying over the mountain and landing on the glacier.  I highly recommend this trip.
Magnificent. Breath taking. Pilot was knowledgeable about the area and his experience as a pilot was evident throughout the flight as he explained weather conditions.

When the 5 of us arrived at K2 for our flight around Mt. Denali, we were asked if we would mind our tour changing and being upgraded to a Glacier Landing tour!!!  Obviously we accepted the upgrade and joined 5 other people on the trip.  We had excellent weather, a very knowledgeable pilot who answered all of our questions about the area and we thoroughly enjoyed the glacier landing at the base camp of climbers for Mt. Denali.

This was the trip of a lifetime. We were lucky to have front seats so got the full benefit. Paul was an excellent pilot and obviously very knowledgeable about the Canyon and its history. A truly wonderful experience
Trip was amazing Eric was great to deal with lots of great service. Enjoyed the insights flexibility of trip and the care and attention to our experience.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: This tour was fantastic whale views along with historical background which was great and overall I felt awesome and uplifted.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: We took our six children on this flight, and Dan was not just a good pilot. He was knowledgeable, had a witty personality, and educated us a lot about the landscapes, logging, and just about everything we saw. This small family operation are just good folk. Their sweet teenage daughter picked us up, Lesly hosted us well and kept safe the personal items we didn't want to take on the ride. They work hard and are just the kind of people/business we love to support.

review_title: Fantastic views of the Grand Canyon & helpful commentary
review_text: Booked this as a birthday present for my husband.  Not disappointed.  50 minute flight over the Grand Canyon with fantastic views and good commentary.  6 of us on the flight.  Good weather helped.  Just down the road from Tusayan hotel and easy parking. Group photo taken before flight and individual photos taken after flight.  Chance to get a DVD of the flight if required.  Once in a lifetime experience.
Breathtaking views! Our pilot was Bubz and we had a great time seeing the island and the Napali Coast.
Amazing time with views that can’t be beat.  Our pilot was knowledgeable and great trivia about the islands.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_title: I made reservations,  I arrived in Talkeetna, I was picked up at my guest house. I arrived at airport. I flew.
review_text: Joe, the pilot, was not just knowledgable and interesting, he put us all at ease with clear safety instructions,  very obvious attention to his task, and some needed comedic relief.. It was one of the most spectacular things I've ever done..and I've done a lot.

review_title: Lovely views of the whole island
review_text: From the moment I called them, they were helpful, polite and easy to schedule. Once we were in the island, they were very informative about the weather and when it would be better to fly, we had to postpone the flight twice b.c of weather conditions. The day we went, it was great. Plane is a little stuffy, need more air circulating around, but its probably the same with any small aircraft. Plane was in great conditions and they offer cold towels and water on board if needed. A picture was taken at the beginning and was emailed to us to keep.

We took the 45 minute helicopter ride out over the Grand Canyon with Maverick helicopters.
This is one of the best things I have ever done in my life, the pilot was so professional, he didn't just take us there, but showed us a lot of interesting things along the way, we did the early tour and had a champagne breakfast when we arrived, there were 6 of us in the helicopter and going out we were able to sit in the front which was awesome. I would recommend this trip.
The tour was amazing. Mike our pilot was knowledgeable and very nice. We would take this tour again when visit next time.

In de ochtend om negen uur een rondvlucht gemaakt boven de Grand Canyon. Het was niet zo goed weer, veel bewolking en af en toe wat regen. De start en landing waren erg comfortabel en de piloot leek dus erg goed om te kunnen gaan met de wat slechtere weersomstandigheden.

Bij de Canyon hadden we een erg goed uitzicht. De ramen zijn groot genoeg om goed te kunnen fotograferen en te filmen. Ook de uitleg tijdens de vlucht is leuk die te horen is door de koptelefoons.

My husband and I decided to go on the Cessna flight over Kauai instead of a helicopter and boy was it a great decision! Bruce and Gina made  our experience one to remember.It was our wedding anniversary and
wonderful Bruce tailored the experience to suit our needs, as I sometimes suffer from motion sickness. We felt completely safe and comfortable.  I highly recommend Wings over Kauai for an amazing birds eye view of a spectacular island.

Due to bad weather we could not go for the booked 45 minute flight, but got downgraded for a shorter one. They said about 30 minutes, but it were barely 20 min. We got a refund of 33 USD for the shorter one, a tour that I couldn't see on their homepage. So all in all we paid about 245 USD for a 20 minute flight. As I remember there are some alternatives which do not charge that much for such a short trip. Flight was okay, but nothing extraordinary.

review_title: Used them before, and would again
review_text:
On a previous trip to Vegas we've used this excellent company to visit the Grand Canyon, so we booked with them again as my son-in-law hadn't seen it. 
We weren't disappointed. As confirmed the previous day by telephone, the pick-up was prompt, the trip to the airport outside Vegas swift and smooth, and a very pleasant wait for our flight at a fascinating little airport, watching the planes and choppers depart and arrive. 
My pregnant daughter - who isn't a good traveller anyway - wasn't sick on the flight, which showed how smooth it was. We got great views of Lake Mead, the Hoover Dam, and the Grand Canyon as we came into Tusayon Airport. My daughter was a little sick after the landing, but soon recovered,
We viewed the safety video and boarded our chopper without too much delay, and the staff were brilliant - attentive and caring. Read the company timeline on the wall while you wait, it's fascinating.
The flight over the canyon was amazing, and the audio commentary was supplemented by interesting and insightful comments from our pilot. 
We returned to the airfield and were met by our driver, Eric, who drove us to Mather point for an hour's viewing, and then around the park a little, giving us interesting historical and personal facts about the area. He was really friendly, polite and pleasant to know.
The airplane flight back to Vegas was rougher than the trip in due to afternoon thermals, but all the passengers slept, apart from my son-in-law, who was rewarded with even better views of the canyon than on the flight in. 
My daughter benefitted from sleeping, as she wasn't ill at all. 
All the drivers, staff and pilots were fantastic, as were the aircraft - Twin Otter with HUGE viewing windows, choppers with larger than normal viewing windows and specially developed whisper jet engines and quiet rotors. 
Brilliant!

review_title: Horrible experience. BEWARE! Bait N Switch
review_text:
Maverick Helicopter is run by very dishonest uncaring management.  I would like to warn fellow travelers to NOT spend your hard earned money with this company.  My wife, infant, and I were excited to take this helicopter tour when we arrived at their facility.  As we are getting ready to board, we noticed they put us in the back seats.  In the front row, there were 4 tall adults, including the helicopter pilot.  When we looked up, we are literally staring at the back of shoulders/necks and we cannot see anything.  Naturally, after spending $600 we were pretty upset, so I asked the ground crew nicely to escort us back to the main counter to speak with a supervisor.  We were greeted rudely by LISA COFFEE.  First words out of her mouth were, "sorry there are no refunds, I could have sold those seats to someone else".  My jaw dropped.  My wife and I tried to explain, we could not see anything and were not happy with the service.  Lisa, instead of offering to put us on another flight or find some type of resolution, unempathetically handed me the general managers card and says "Call him, if you have a problem, but you are not getting your money back". So no helicopter ride and robbed $600, we left the building for our first experience at the Grand Canyon Maverick Tours.  I called the GM shortly after (Ted Yasuda) and got his voice recorder.  I left him a detailed message, with what just happened with an optimistic spirit that somehow this would get resolved.  I never received a call back from Ted Yasuda, I left several messages and still no call back, when I got back home from our Grand Canyon trip I emailed him twice, then he finally responded with an even more arrogant demeanor than his colleague Lisa Coffey.  After a few email exchanges,  I summarize "I will not be issuing a refund" with no apologies or attempts to bring light to a dissatisfied customer robbed of their money and experience they will never get back.   

Bottom line, we planned and saved months to take our first trip to the Grand Canyon, a lifelong dream of my wife.  I surprised her with these helicopter tour tickets, after much sacrifice at work to be robbed blind and completely disregarded by Maverick Helicopters.  This is not how you treat any customer when you are running a business and providing a public service.   As many of you read, there are many complaints from other passengers with similar stories, and yet, they still do nothing.  This should have been disclosed on their trip advisor advertisement or when we called to make the reservations.  It is understandable, that not everyone can ride in the front, but don't charge the same fees and be upfront with customers.  This way it is the consumers, that choose what experience they want to purchase.
I wish every reader, a great journey and safe trip to the Grand Canyon, but do yourself a favor and stay far away from this company.

We did the McKinley tour with glacier landing.  This was the first excursion we did in Alaska.  We had a wonder time.  Our pilot was great. He shared a lot of helpful information and facts about the area. The flight was very smooth.  The other staff was very friendly and helped with reservations.  We took our 9 and 11 year olds with us.  They had a great time. Must add glacier landing.  Worth the extra money.

We booked months prior to our trip to Alaska. I called to make the reservations, and they couldn't have been nicer! The day of our flight was finally here and we were excited. When we arrived for check in, they were extremely honest, that the weather was deteriorating, and they could not fly the flight we had booked. They offered an alternate flight for a reduced rate but were very honest of what we would or would not be able to see. They gave us a choice of a full refund or this alternate flight. We chose a refund, which they processed immediately. Their care of customers is unmatched! Kudos!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: We took off from Talkeetna on the most incredible flight. The weather was perfect and the views spectacular. Our pilot was wonderful enjoying every moment himself. He made sure that both sides of the plane had equal opportunity to see the mountains and glaciers. We landed on a glacier and the pilot was happy to take a group photo. A wonderful experience I will always treasure.

Even though most of our trip consisted of heavy rainfall and cancelled/postponed tours, air ventures was easily the highlight of our trip! Trish was awesome in assisting with the scheduling of our tour (and my proposal)and the pilot was awesome as well. I definitely recommend setting up an air tour with air ventures if you’re visiting Kauai!

We had an Amazing trip with Joe flying over Alaska’s magnificent mountains! Our family really enjoyed the beauty and all of Joe’s helpful information and his expertise. The staff is super friendly and very helpful with little ones. This is a MUST experience for the entire family! 
Thank you K2! ❤️

review_title: Flying to and around Denali and landing on a glacier
review_text: This trip was once in a lifetime! We had incredible views of Denali - the whole range, and landed on a glacier. Beautiful! Our pilot Jack was really great and shared a lot of info about what we were seeing. Just amazing trip!
Wonderful way to experience the awe of the canyon while covering the south and north rim in one flight. Do the long flight and get the flight video. Nice job guys.

review_title: Roche Harbor to Renton was a blast! Best way home from a family reunion on San Juan.
review_text: I have flown in small planes before, but never a seaplane.  The experience was as great as I had hoped. Taking off from the water was exhilarating. Terrific low altitude views of the islands and the vast Salish Sea.  Flight was super smooth. Almost too smooth; I’d hope for a little bit of small plane motion but only got that as we banked to make our approach into Renton. The young woman shuttle driver to SeaTac was personable, fun and professional. En route to SeaTac I asked her about flights to Alderbrook next summer. I am hooked!

Talkeetna Air Taxi was wonderful to work with from the time that we booked until our flight touched down after visiting the glacier!  We used Talkeetna Air Taxi following a 7-night Princess cruise for the Mt. McKinley flightseeing and glacier landing combination.  We originally planned to use a BOGOF coupon in the Alaskan Tour Saver coupon book, however our dates of travel made the coupon obsolete.  As a courtesy, Talkeetna Air offered a 20% discount on flights for our dates.  Boy, was it worth the money! 

Our pilot's name was Will.  Not only was he patient in pointing out various landmarks and other points of interest (Mt. McKinley, Ruth Glacier, etc.), but also courteous enough to take photos of those in our group. The beautiful scenery seen on this flight compares to nothing else.  The plane ride was exciting and everyone has a window seat and a headset.  The glacier landing was very smooth, and not nearly as cold as I would have imagined. Our flight departed at 4 PM and when we landed, the sun was was still bright and shining.  The view from atop the glacier is absolutely amazing!!!!! This is a must do, and much preferred over fllightseeing in Juneau, AK. 

If you visit Talkeetna, flightseeing is a must-do and Talkeetna would be my recommendation. They are the best at what they do.

This was my first trip to the Grand Canyon and wow what a doozy it was!  We took our tour from the Sedona airport.  This was an experience that my husband has wanted to do for a long time.  Our two boys (10 & 13) were also with us.  Let me just say that I do not like to fly and I definitely do not like to fly in small airplanes!  I was a nervous wreck boarding the plane.  There were already 5 other guests on board who had come from Phoenix.  Our flight to the Grand Canyon and over part of it was extremely bumpy and even though I was not enjoying the ride, I did enjoy the views.  I was thankful for the big headphones that we wore to help drown out the noise and to give us a commentary about what we were seeing.  I can't tell you a word they said because I was just focused on the background music that was helping to relax me!!  I was glad when we arrived at the airport by the Grand Canyon.  The Pink Jeep came and picked us up.  It was extremely cold and windy when we arrived!!  The Pink Jeep had a plastic covering around the back and blankets to keep us warm.  We drove into the park and went to 3 different locations to see portions of the canyon.  They provided us with a boxed lunch and water.  Then it was back to the airport and back into the plane.  Our ride back was slightly shorter (30 min) but just as bumpy.  My boys did admit that they did not really care for the plane ride because of all the turbulence but my husband who has taken flying lessons in the past had the time of his life!!  This was my once in a lifetime tour of the Grand Canyon and I don't regret a moment of it.

review_title: The BEST Way To See The Island!
review_text: It was a really nice ride.  The pilot (Harry) talked to us the whole way, pointing out the varioius sites.  Shortly after we got up in the air, I asked him to see if he could find us any whales to see....and in less than 3 minutes, we saw a group of 4 whales!  Saw alot of things I never would have seen by car.  Very professional company!  Thanks for the ride!  Tammy from Ohio

review_title: Break the bank, but don't miss it.
review_text:
What can I say that others haven't already said.  We have spent 10 days in Alaska (first time) and this was the absolute highlight.  Flight was beautiful beyond belief.  I originally did not plan on the glacier landing, but it was really cool.  Our pilot was a great host and perfect flying through the mountains and did a really excellent job of making sure people on both sides of the plane got a good view.  Flight was smoother than expected.  I can't recommend it to highly.
Small tip:  make sure your ear phones do not come unplugged and you miss the commentary.

review_title: Fabulous Full Day Trip - Air flight Over GC, Breath Taking Hike, Float Through Glen Canyon - Don't Miss It
review_text: The one hour plane flight over the Grand Canyon was the highlight of our 4 day Grand Canyon Trip. Captain Sam and First Officer Zach were incredible hosts and made the trip for my grand daughter very, very special. This was a my gift to her for her graduation from college. The views from the plane were fantastic. My second favorite part of the entire trip was this trip's hike through Lower Antelope Canyon - so unusual and beautiful. The guides for all three parts - air, hike and float - were outstanding. Don't miss this trip if you can afford it - it's well worth the price tag.

review_title: Fly and sail 4000 miles not to be picked up!!!
review_text:
First of all book with another airline ,there's lots.We booked our trip through the web and were told to meet at the sunshine sign outside the tourist information centre in Ketchikan at 3pm, flying at 3-30'we were sent a photo to clarify the place.
Our ship docked at 2.30 right next to an information centre,but there was no sunshine sign,so we walked 10 mins into the centre found another tourist information centre with the sunshine sign.the only problem been was the information centre photo was of a difference appearance.
We waited here to be picked up,as after making inquiries we were sure we had found the right place.at 3-25 we were becoming very anxious as no one had picked us up,and we were due to fly in 5 mins.we noticed other people been picked up from other companies and taken to a car park in the distance,so my husband walked over and found a mini bus with the name of the our  airline on it.
The man told us he was from that company but wasn't there to pick us up,so he tried ringing the office,but just got an answer phone,so he said he would take us anyway as he had heard over the radio they had been looking for 2 people.
When we arrived even more worried at this point,my husband asked the girl on reception why we hadn't been collected ,she did not give us an answer,and my husband tried to explain why we were so anxious ,wrong time,apparently we didn't fly until 4pm not 3.30 pm, and incorrect photo provided,At this moment  another woman who we believe was called Patsy,stepped in and told us ,you have an old photo,we explained "that's the one we were sent, and the time" her reply ,"well that's your faults for booking through a 3rd party, but gave no explanation to why we weren't picked up,then she said ,well why didn't you phone us,but it was on answer phone ,was our answer ,so she replied "well what's your problem your here now , Go Fly!,, "in a very sarcastic,aggressive manner,then went into a glass office and starred at us,the young girl behind the reception did apologise and said she would ring the 3rd party and tell them that they had given us an old photo and the wrong time to meet.
We did have a lovely flight with a lovey pilot called Sam,his kindness and lovely personality made a terrible experience thanks to the rude, awful woman, into a great experience and to not spoilt the whole episode, which we' d had the privelidge of paying for ruined.
But the worse was then to come,she was waiting for us when we came back,and said "I will take these people back,"she never spoke to us just opened the van door and stared at us.It obviously wasn't her position to drive the mini bus ,but we soon found out why,she took us back to our ship,and not to the Sunshine shine sign where we were told to be at for collection,when we asked her why she'd done this, bearing in mind it's a 10mins walk back into the town,a disagreement broke out,where she held the door open told  us to get out and said " I'm done" .What a terrible woman,we had travelled all that way from England, only meeting lovely people like ourselves to have the most unfortunate experience of meeting this awful bully of a woman,well we "Are done "now and won't be reading your reply.
Oh and by the way Patsy the English  defination of nice is :pleasant,good natured or kind.that certainly was not you.You did your utmost to spoil it for us,but thanks to Sam you didn't .

review_title: Wings Over Kauai Better Than Helicopter
review_text: Wings Over Kauai is much better than a helicopter to flight see Kauai. My wife and I have done both and my wife got nauseous on the helicopter but not on Wings Over Kauai.  I like it more because you can see the amazing beauty of Kauai much better when you are not so close as you are on a helicopter.   We have visited Kauai more than 30 times and  Kings Over Kauai  is  more affordable and a better value than a helicopter.  We like it so much that we are repeat customers.  Wings Over Kauai is Mo Bettah!  Hang Loose!  G. Smith Redmond, WA

We were picked up from our hotel as planned and driven to the airport. The weather was cold and some people had to buy extra clothing so ...... be prepared for any weather as we had left sunshine in Las Vegas!  The flight there was in a 16 seater plane. We landed and were transported in a bus to 2 different sights with instructions where to go to see the best views. Michael, our tour guide was great and said he was the best!  The views were spectacular and like paintings (almost unreal!)  The flight back was very bumpy as it was extremely windy - all the helicopters had been grounded. What an experience! Very professional company.
Was incredible! It was a good service very professional we enjoyed it and we had a lot of fun. the view is amazing! I recommend that you do this air tour!

This place was awesome. They did everything to get us up in the sky. Mother Nature just wasn’t having it. Leighan our pilot was the best .. I would definitely recommend them to anyone going to the area. If I’m lucky enough to go back I will definitely fly with them.

review_title: Exceeded my expectations...and my expectations were high!
review_text: My wife and I celebrated our 47th anniversary by spending a week on Kauai. Probably our most remarkable activity was touring the island by airplane. The airplane was comfortable, and the pilot's running narrative was exceptionally interesting and educational. Don't even hesitate to schedule your own tour!

Excellent trip from start to finish. Very friendly, courteous service, from the welcome, through the boarding and flight, to the transfer back to town. Super smooth take-off, flight and landing, including the one on the fjord. We had a long flight over the wonderful scenery and were blessed with good weather too. Couldn't always hear the commentary clearly, but otherwise can't fault it. Thank you.

Detours was the name of the mini coach company which drove us from Phoenix to the grand canyon and back. Of course the Maveric helcopter tour of the canyon was an amazing highlight of the day, but the 500 mile round trip there and back showed us lots more. Our guide had a great knowledge of everwhere we went from Sedona to Flagstaff and back through the Indian reservation. Our visit was may 2014, so a while ago but unforgettable.
This was the highlight of our AK trip.  The glacier landing was magical.  I can't recommend it enough.  If you can afford only one AK tour, do this one!

review_title: Lots of fun and a great value for scenic flying
review_text: Our pilot JT did a great job informing us about what to expect on our flight.  It was somewhat windy and cloudy with scattered showers, but the ride was smooth and the landing was very smooth.  We flew up and down the Napali coast so passengers on both sides could get a good view.  The plane we flew in had one window seat for all passengers so we could see well and take pictures.  We had headsets, but mine did not work as well for me as I would have liked, so check it out before the plane takes off.  I wore dark clothing and did not have a problem with reflection.  Less important here than it was in a helicopter. We had taken a helicopter flight on another island and for the money, this was definitely superior as the cost was nearly a third..

I took my son for he’s 12 birthday . He totally loved it , he was afraid at first but the people there were so nice that they make him feel so comfortable and relax . The view was one in the life time experience and I would highly recommend

Westwind is unquestionably one of the best experiences I have had in travel.  We were scheduled to fly to the Grand Canyon on December 28th.  On Christmas Eve, we saw that weather might be bad that day.  We called the office late on December 24th and they promptly rescheduled us for a private flight on December 26th.

The flight, customer service, and hiking opportunities were world-class.  We have traveled the world and this trip is on our top three bucket list, along with having dinner on the Eiffel Tower (Jules Verne) and hiking to Waipoo Falls on Kauai, Hawaii.

Thank you Westwind!
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_text: Eric was a great pilot!  He let my wife fly the plane!  The views and scenery was amazing and I felt like we took a once in a lifetime trip

review_title: Don’t miss this!  Worth every penny!
review_text:
You just can’t imagine the beauty of the island till you see it like this, a totally different perspective.
Well worth the money!
Very professional and friendly service.

I’m a large lady and did not have to pay extra that I would have had to, if I took a helicopter.

It’s not fun to get weighed but it was a very discrete process.

There is a surprise at the end, but don’t want to spoil it for you!

Go, you won’t be sorry!

Outstanding pilot (Ray) who was very skilled at handling the aircraft and extremely knowledgeable about the island.  He provided a continuous explanation of the sights as well as their backstory in a manner that was like chatting with a friend.  Each passenger is equipped with headset/microphone so can easily chat with the pilot and among each other.  Flight got us into canyons which are inaccessible by any other means, close to dozens of magnificent waterfalls, hidden beaches, and the spectacular Napali Coast, as well as a couple of whales.  Although we’ve been to Kauai several times, we saw much more of it then ever before and learned a great deal about it’s history and infrastructure.  Everyone at AirVentures was welcoming and friendly; we were treated as friends or family by everyone there.  Aircraft was comfortable & spacious.  Each seat was next to a large bubble window which made viewing and photography easy.  Couldn’t have asked for a better flight experience.

review_title: Maverick helicopter  tour of the Grand Canyon
review_text: If you are looking for an amazing experience and the best way to see the Grand Canyon book with Maverick.  Easy booking by phone. Courteous and efficient check-in process. Our pilot- Barclay was great. He provided enough commentary without being over the top. Jaw dropping!!!
Un esperienza fantastica ......partenza las vegas durata volo circa 20 minuti elicottero bellissimo ritorno con sosta nel deserto a fare rifornimento.....500 dollari davvero ben spesi....

review_title: The best way to see Miami Beach without the crowds
review_text: We hired the plane for our family of four. Great experience to fly up and down the beach and the pilot was very friendly and informative. Be prepared to get your feet a little wet though, as you get on and off. Sailing or swimming shoes would be ideal.
This trip was incredible.  The views are amazing and our pilot, Liam, gave an informative narration throughout the trip.  Highly recommend.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: I was able to cross this off my list with a smile on my face!
review_text: Phenomenal experience from start to finish.  Pilot not only described what you were seeing, he answered all questions.

Last year we had the amazing experience of flying with Eric in the airplane...wonderful!
This year we flew with Kevin in the Waco...truly a fun time!  It was more difficult getting good camera shots from the biplane, but we decided beforehand to have a GoPro attached...good choice!  Kevin gave us a thorough fly-over of Kauai...made even more spectacular by the hundreds of waterfalls from the previous night's rain!  AirVentures is a first-rate company with impressive staff!

review_title: Best activity of our Alaska trip
review_text: Highlight of the trip! Stunning views, smooth ride. Splurge for the glacier landing if you can, it’s incredible. Also just because it’s a little cloudy on the ground doesn’t mean you won’t have pretty skies in the mountains.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: My wife was reluctant on taking a helicopter so this was our option to seeing Kauai from the air. It is a must do while on Kauai, we drove around the first day, but from the air it is breathtaking. Bruce is a great pilot and makes sure everyone is at ease, equipped with Bose headsets everyone can communicate. There were only four of us on the plane, so I got the back area to myself  to roam freely getting some great photos in.(wear dark colors to reduce glare)  We were on the cruise ship, and it was a free shuttle to the shopping mall were Ellen picked us up. It was a great way to end our last day in Kauai. This is a class act operation, they even give you a DVD free of some of the highlights. Bruce and Ellen...........Thanks for a great time   Paul & Kathy

review_title: We never got our flight in but I would recommend them based on safety!!
review_text: We spent two days in Talkeetna hoping to do a flight around Mt. Mckinley and do the glacier landing.  From the time I made reservations (months in advance) I was completely impressed with the professionalism of this company.  Due to weather we were unable to make the flight and although they tried to reschedule us when the weather cleared we were unable to stay in the area another day.  We had a fully packed schedule while visiting multiple cities so our time in Talkeetna was limited.  Those that came off the plane while we were in the building had rave reviews of the flight.  We went through the check in process which was extremely easy and when our flight ended up not going out they refunded our deposit.  I can tell safety is there top concern and that says it all.  If planning a trip to Talkeetna put in enough time to be able to schedule another flight incase you don't get out on the originally scheduled one.

This morning I took a tour of Kauai with Air Ventures and it was better than I expected. JT took us so many places and made sure we all had great views for pictures. It was a wonderful adventure in the air. I even saw my resort from the plane. One of the bonuses was seeing a few whales swimming. After we landed I drove to one of the waterfalls for a more up close look. I especially appreciated the care and safety measures before and during the flight. It seemed like everyone in the plane had a great time. If you’re still on the fence about going...do it! Have a blast like we did.

For three summers I have done this gig with family and friends. If you go in July during the mountain school training ask to land on Ruth's Glacier. This is an awesome event landing in the snow. If the weather is bad, just hang close and you will get to do the mountain sometimes. Fling around Denali is an amazing view. Usually they ask for reservations with a deposit, but I have found times when I did not have to do this. Just walk in and check their schedule compared to yours an let this be priority unless the fish are running. Kings run in July and reds about first week of August. K2 operates great equipment with very experienced pilots. Make this an attraction to do. Ask your pilot to for the seat up front for you of a kid. That is really special!!!

I booked a Seaplane trip in October 2013 for a flight in April 2014. The day of flight flight arrived (my last day in San Francisco) and I spent the morning heading to Pier 39 for pick up. 

The collection never arrived. When I called the office I was advised no flights were operating that day and although apologetic the staff couldn't understand how the online reservation system let me book for a day when no flights were operating. I "slipped" through the system. I was promised a refund would happen immediately. 

After 12 days I still hadn't received my refund and I emailed 3 times with no response. I finally called (8 hours time difference) and was advised that my refund had "failed". No effort had been made to check or resolve this in those 12 days. I do now finally have my refund. 

I'd recommend being 100% sure your flight is going to happen before wasting precious holiday time getting to an agreed pick up point (at cost) only to be let down. Thoroughly disappointed.

My husband and I flew with maverick helicopter tours from las Vegas to grand canyon in January 2013.
We were picked up by tour bus 8am from our hotel. We made a few stops at other hotels, before we arrived at maverick tours. By 10 am we were in the air on a small plane heading to the grand canyon. We arrived there in less than an hour. (south point) We all boarded a coach and before we knew it we had enter the grand canyon park, eating our packed lunch which was provided. We had an hour to look around before we boarded our helicopters ( 6 people per helicopter plus pilot). We had paid extra for the helicopter tour. It was worth every penny. The views were fabulous !!!
If you choose not to do the helicopter ride the coach went to another view point, with more 
amazing views.
Everyone looked after us. Before we knew it we were back in las Vegas at 3.30 pm heading back to our hotels. What an amazing day.
The company was organised and so helpful. We would recommend them to anyone.
It was an amazing experience. Thanks to maverick tours.

Another great trip with Seawind Aviation and Steve as pilot of our Beaver.  We had a picture perfect day landing on one of the many lakes.  The plane landed smoothly and backed right up against a mountain.  We were able to get out and hike up for some awesome pictures & picked some ripe berries. 
As we soared past the mountains he took us close up to view some mountain sheep on the return flight back to Ketchikan.  
A great family local owned business.  This was the second time we booked independently with Steve & Leslie Kamm.  Highly recommend this trip.

review_title: Fantastic-the best part of my Alaskan vacation
review_text: I was very apprehensive about flying in a small plane, but this was awesome.  Pilot was very friendly and provided lots of information as we flew over Mt. McKinley.    After we landed, I was ready to go again!!!!

Our party of 4 had one of the best views of Denali ever thanks to K2 Aviation and Chris our pilot.  After a thorough safety briefing we loaded up and headed out.  We were blessed with crystal clear skies and smooth air. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and provided a lot of color about the area.  He was more concerned with making sure we got a great flight versus just watching the clock to take us back.  Truest a once in a lifetime experience.

Es impactante ver el Gran Cañón desde el aire. Los empleados, el piloto y todos los empleados muy amables. Importante es decir que no me mareé y eso es difícil pues me mareo hasta en un columpio. Se lo dije al piloto y estuvo magnífico.
Tener en cuenta que hay obras en el parque y a veces te paran hasta media hora, cosa que te puede hacer llegar tarde a la cita de salida. Nosotros llegamos sólo 5 minutos antes!

Prenotammo da casa per tempo questo volo, affidandoci alle esperienze di chi già aveva provato. Non siamo stati delusi.
