Il giorno precedente, e la mattina stessa del volo avevamo visitato il Grand Canyon dalla sommità del bordo sud, lasciandoci stupefatti dallo spettacolo che si apriva sotto i nostri occhi. Il pomeriggio in volo è stato qualcosa di superlativo. Abbiamo visto scorci del Colorado e dei suoi affluenti, impossibili da vedere altrimenti. Esperienza, quella del sorvolo, che consiglio a tutti. La compagnia è affidabile, ed è la prima ad avere effettuato voli turistici. Il personale competente ed affabile. Abbiamo avuto un pilota oltremodo simpatico. Dimenticavo, durante il volo è possibile ascoltare le spiegazioni di ciò che state osservando in italiano. Grazie per la bellissima esperienza.

This was by far the most amazing excursion we have ever been on!  We did a flightseeing trip around Denali and then landed on the Ruth Glacier.  It didn’t hurt that Denali was showing all of her glory on the day we took this trip!  Our pilot was very professional, and the love he has for what he does came through resoundingly.  If you go to Talkeetna, make this a priority!

That plane ride is al lifetime experience!! 

Just do it!!

Great captain and most beautiful view, defiantly worth it.

Horrible experience when the third party booking company doesn't communicate with the actual servicing company. And the policies of the booking company don't apply with the servicing company. I had a hard time getting a hold of anyone after my booking was canceled due to inclimate weather but they were not understanding when I followed original booking cancelation policy. After finally communicating with a supervisor I was told I would get a refund but then weeks later I was told no. Horrible customer service.
tour_name: 30_115_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour2025-03-01

review_text: We had something to celebrate on our trip to the US. In orde rto make it a memorable occasion, I booked the 45 min helicopter tour with Maverick. Tusayan is conveniently located just minutes from Grand Canyon NP. and the airport is well signposted. When we got to Maverick, we weer weighed in and then waited for the crowd to gather until the pilots called out the names of their passengers. The helicopters are pretty big (8-seaters). In the from there are 3 seats next tot he pilot, and 4 in the back. In our helicopter, there were only 4 passengers, 3 of whom sat in the front. I was one of them and I must say the views are amazing. The views from the rim are spectacular, but there is nothing like a bir's eye view of the Grand Canyon. Our pilot was very knowledgeable. Besides knowing how to fly the chopper he was also a very good tour guide. The whole setup at Maverick is very professional, from the moment you arrive until the moment you leave the airport, everything is well taken care of. A fabulous experience. Not the cheapest trip ever, but money wll spent.
Highly recommended - 5 islands, very informative, beautiful scenery, especially the Molokini crater!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: The plan was to make a glacier landing and hike on the glacier but unfortunately weather conditions would not permit.  We were offered our choice of a refund or a longer sightseeing flight to another set of glaciers.  We chose the sight seeing flight and enjoyed an 1,5 hour flight in an Otter viewing the spectacular mountains and glaciers!  Well worth doing!  The pilot was very informative and gave us a great flight!

We recently flew with Kim, a pilot with Redtail Aviation, and had a wonderful time.  We have spent a lot of time in the Moab, Utah area in our Jeep.  We visit every spring and are always amazed by the awesome landscape we find while 4-wheeling in the area.   This flight put a whole new perspective to the area!  We could look down and see some of our 4-wheeling trails but now could see on the 'other side' of the rocks.   There are arches in Canyonland that would be very difficult to see from the trails, but Kim pointed them out for us!    We highly recommend this flight!

review_title: Spectacular views and very professional and knowledgeable pilot!
review_text: We were blessed with a break in the weather and blue skies. Unfortunately the haze in the high elevation did not allow for us to see Denali but otherwise the views were breathtaking!  Our pilot, Will, was exceptional. We felt safe and and he gave us so much information about what we were seeing!  We absolutely would recommend this excursion!
There’s really no way to describe the trip, you just have to take it.  Worth every penny.  I’ve never had views like this before.  The bird’s eye view is unrivaled.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: It was safe and also informative. Pilot Brian was friendly and took good care of us. It is an understatement to call Kauai beautiful because it is much more than that. Thanks to air ventures for giving an aerial view of the place.

review_title: Can't get refund after they canceled last minute
review_text: I contacted them an hour before the flight to confirm before I rented a car to drive the hour. There was a light rain so I was concerned and they assured me the flight was going to take place. Then I learned the man I spoke to wasn't the decision-maker and a pilot called just before the flight and cancelled. The rain was mild and hadn't changed in that hour. I cannot seem to get a refund  It's been 2 months.

review_title: Totally different and amazing way to see Canyonlands
review_text: We went on the 50m Canyonlands/Arches flight on a pefect clear morning. Words cant describe the view. Gives you a whole new appreciation for the parks. Our pilots were great and gave a very thorough briefing and description of the flight, plus a very informative commentary throughout. We have done lots of hiking in the parks, but this flight really completed the visit. Perfect.
It was an amazing experience with a nice view over Miami. The pilot was great and we had a good time up there.

The pilot was amazing and made our trip so much better. He made sure everyone got a good view of the glaciers. The service was great. I forgot my coat at the hotel and they were kind enough to let me borrow one.

review_title: Flight to Denali with Glacier Landing
review_text: We took a flight to Denali wit a glacier landing and it was the best excursion of our trip. Clay was our pilot and due to the clouds around the mountain he worked his flying magic to get us a view of the peak. The glacier landing was unbelievable and an experience you should have on your bucket list. Also viewing the glacier rivers were exquisite. TAT was an excellent company and I highly suggest them for your flight-seeing excursion. Definitely worth the money.

review_title: Great Experience...Would Definitely Do It Again!
review_text:
We were considering doing a heli tour, but I came across Wings on here and saw how well-rated and how much cheaper it was.  Well, I'm soooo glad I went with Wings (flew on 8/19).  It's a small family-run operation and there's such a personal touch to it.  Bruce and Ellen are so nice and accommodating.  They even took our picture before we took off and used it for the cover of the CD they gave us (didn't check it out yet to see exactly what's on it yet).

They provide some water and ginger candies which are supposed to help with any air sickness.  During the taxi to the runway, Bruce goes over the checklist with the co-pilot (whichever passenger gets the lucky seat) which is a nice little lesson on the different buttons in the cockpit and how things work with the plane...my engineering mind was content.  We had a nice, rather smooth ride.  Bruce did a great bit of narration throughout the entire ride and engaged us as well...he knew all of our names right off the bat too.  There are some things you just can't see from a car or a hike which makes the plane right  all the more worthwhile.

I've never done a helicopter ride, but the family members I was with said that it was definitely better than a heli ride.  I'm sure having Bruce as the pilot surely helped with that assessment.  Go ahead and give Wings Over Kauai a try...you won't regret it!!

review_title: Views Above It All ~ Beautiful Kauai
review_text:
Wings Over Kauai is the BEST in every sense.  They were very easy to work with in setting up the flight well before we docked in Kauai.  They gave clear information on the "how to's" of pickup and drop off.  Since we arrived via cruise ship that information is very important.

The flight was wonderful....awesome....we could not have asked for more.  The pilot was great and very knowledgable about the island.  Everything was perfect.

Our thanks go out to everyone at Wings Over Kauai.  This was an exceptional tour and we were very happy to have discovered the true beauty of Kauai.....views from above.
There is so much that can only be seen and appriecated by air in Kauai. As a private pilot I can attest to their attention to safety and professionalism.

review_title: this is a must in Kauai
review_text: First I wanted to do this trip on a doors-off helicopter to be able to do better photos, but the two companies I found did not meet my requirements (Jack Harter Helicopters: there is a risk you get the middle seat from which you do not see properly and cannot really take photos, while Mauna Loa Helicopters unfortunately do not accept solo travellers) so I finally chose Air Ventures and it was a good choice, also much cheaper than any helicopter flights :) Our nice pilot, Desi, shared a lot of interesting info about the island and the views were truly amazing. If you are visiting several islands and want to do only one air trip, Kauai is the one. All in all, it was a fantastic experience that I would recommend to anyone. Warning: wear dark clothes, even your hands' reflection might be visible on the photos.

review_title: Mt. Denali National Park air tour
review_text: We had a very enjoyable 90-minute air tour of Mt. Denali National Park, seeing the peaks and glaciers up close. The pilot was informative and pleasant, making it a very enjoyable experience.

We did our Air Ventures tour of Kauai on December 17 with Harry as our Pilot. He was very professional and did a great job of making sure that we saw all of the beautiful sights of Kauai. My favorite place to see, of course, was the Napoli Coast. I was very glad we got a great look at it by air, as our Sunset Dinner Cruise down the Napoli Coast had to be rerouted to the Southern Coast due to the intense waves. I would definitely recommend this air tour to everyone that wants to see the sights of the entire Island in an hour. I would do it again in a heartbeat.

Must do!!! One of my most rememberable experiences while I was in Alaska. The staff was extremely flexible and understanding  due to rainy weather. We flew with Chris, who was very friendly and knowledgeable. The views were breathtaking!! Even though we were initially told we wouldn’t be able to take part in the glacier landing, the weather cleared up just in time and Chris was able to land the plane safely. I would definitely recommend this company and if I’ve ever back in Alaska I’ll be taking another flight myself!

It's hard to choose what the best part was. The flight over the coastlines were great, the stop in Hilo at Ken's pancakes was an awesome stop, and the waterfalls on the way back were amazing! Eric also let my kids take turns flying. All-around great experience.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: An amazing aerial tour of Kauai.  Eric was our pilot and he assured our safety and comfort and provided lots of information about the island.  Worth every penny.  Highly recommend this tour.  Thanks Eric and Kaycee.

There are so many reasons to go with WOK vs. a helicopter tour. But the top reasons are:

1. Personalized service!! We chose to do the small cessna tour for my husband and I, along with our 9 mo old daughter. We got a private tour with Capt. Bruce. If we had booked a helicopter tour, we would have been sitting on top of other strangers. We also received a FREE digital picture in front of the plane before the tour. Most companies would charge you for this type of thing. 

2. Price - for half the cost of a helicopter tour, WOK is really a great bang for your buck! We also appreciated the fact that we didn't have to pay for our daughter either.

I would without a doubt recommend this tour for anyone! Save your money and go with WOK. You won't regret it at all. 

Tip: Book this at the beginning of your time on Kauai just in case the weather is less than ideal to fly. We did this and I am glad we did because we had a lot of flexibility when the fog was really bad one day.

Assuming the cost is not an issue this is very well worth it.  Extremely smooth flight and landings.  Landing on the Glacier standing look around at the mountains towering above is incredible.  Sitting at a restaurant an hour later it all seemed just a dream. 
Great pilot.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Incredible experience, great way to see the whole Grand Canyon!
review_text:
The flight was incredible with great narration and awesome sights! Well worth it. 

What detracted from the experience was the lack of information up front, even when I called 1 day prior to the trip to confirm. I was staying at Bright Angel lodge (18 minute drive from the airport), no-one told me that there was no transportation to the airport, no bus, taxi, or Uber. I had to pay a private person $100 each way to get to the airport and back, the only option was not to do the flight after I paid for it.

My copilot and I were on a 35 hour layover in Anchorage and were looking for something fun for the day.  The weather was good, so we headed to Talkeetna.  We checked at K2 when we got into town and they had 2 seats on the 3:00pm flight. Check in was smooth and easy (thanks staff!)

All I can say is WOW!!  best experience ever!  Chad was our pilot and did a great job of making all the passengers feel at ease.  He flew the Otter like the expert he is.  

The views were the most spectacular I have ever seen.  I don't think there is a better way to see Denali.  Absolutely a fantastic experience and have already recommended it to all my family and friends.  Thanks K2, Chad, and staff!

The weather was iffy at best.  We were debating on whether to go or try on our ride back.  The owner was very honest with us and would give us our money back if we wanted.  The weather ended up clearing up enough so we went!  So glad we did.  Flying into the mountain/glacier was incredible!  The pilot was great!  She was very knowledgeable and nicely did the family pictures!   Highly recommend this company.  It's well worth the money!   A great tour!

I’d flown with K2 a few years ago on the Grand Denali flight and was looking for a repeat this year. Unfortunately we awoke to heavy rain and a low ceiling; an email from K2 offered options from canceling with a full refund, re-scheduling, or staying in touch to see how the day developed. We opted for the latter and got a call mid-morning telling us that the clouds had lifted enough to make shorter flights up to the lower glaciers. We decided to go for it and even this limited tour didn’t disappoint. We spent about an hour with excellent pilot and guide Mark, who gave everyone a good view of the glaciers and spectacular terrain of southern Denali. Even on a gray day there were amazing sights and great photo opportunities. I’d fly with K2 any time and look forward to doing it again!

From the minute we arrived at the terminal and were greeted by Sherry and Capt. Bruce it was a wonderful experience. We felt that we came to see our good, old friends whom we haven’t seen for a long time. The check in took only a few minutes and we were ready to board the plane.  Bruce is an expert pilot who has flown over 5,000 flights over Kauai so you may feel extremely safe, relax and enjoy the flight.  The flight experience was out of this world; with the cost being very reasonable we recommend everyone visiting Kauai to take a flight. In addition to being an expert pilot Capt. Bruce has a vast knowledge of the island history, flora, fauna, etc., which he shared with us during the flight.  We highly recommend taking a flight with the “Wings over Kauai”!!!

Chamil and Tatiana, Colorado, USA
Amazing views. Focus on the beautiful islands of Maui and the whales. Superior flight. Learned so much about Maui.

We flew over the Denali Mountains then landed on a glacier. So surreal.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable of our surroundings. Lots of information about the Denali mountains.  
We almost didn’t get to land because of clouds and wind. But everything worked out in the end we were all safe on a bright sunny day. With no clouds.

Great experience, the pilot was personable and very knowledgeable about the area.  He pointed out many areas of interest, and knew a lot of the history of the various areas.  Highly recommend this tour!.  Don't arrive too early though - there waiting area is unattended and minimal.  Wear shoes/clothes that can get wet, and if you have mobility issues let them know before booking the tour. The boarding facilities are minimal also, and it is a seaplane!
Absolument parfait malgré un prix un peu élevé, ça en vaut la peine et notre pilote, David, était très agréable.

Another Bucket list item and nature wonder . It’s a bit of a walk although with some effort there was 4 people who took a guy with a wheel chair to see this .  We loved this , its only 10 minutes from Antelope canyon . Easy to do both in one day .
Beautiful trip of Marin County and SF.  Super skilled and friendly pilot made the trip even more fun!

If you have a chance to go, definitely do it. I was able to do the glacier landing. Our weather that day was perfect. It is amazing to fly around the range and a great way to get a perspective of how big Denali actually is. We landed on the Ruth glacier. It was amazing to feel how warm it actually was up there. We were fine with just sweatshirts that day. We did here that it is always good to bring layers though. It is hard to describe what being on a glacier is like. It is just something that has to be experienced. The planes are small, so if you have claustrophobia that might be an issue. Also if you get motion sickness or can't stand turbulence, you might want to take something before your flight. When coming off the glacier and back to the airport, we encountered thermals which created a short period of turbulence. Still definitely worth every minute of it.

review_title: A wow eperience for my wife...
review_text: The intention to do it was 6 months ago, however the booking was made only a few days ahead. The previous few days of bad weather incorporated snow, and it appears that may have put on extra flights at 8 AM. There were 5 helicopters flying out at that time! The skies were blue without a cloud. Although I am quite light, I got the rear window seat, however my wife had the most amazing experience of her life being on the opposite side of the pilot, the best seat in the “house”, window in front and below. This was the 45-50 minute Spirit flight, with ample time to take in the canyon and photographs, avoiding the no-fly zone across the main part of the canyon, going east, then across to the north rim, and then crossing back to the south beyond Hermit’s rest. The commentary could have been better avoiding cheesy jokes.

Maverick is very professional. A truly amazing ride touring most of the Grand Canyon. The pilot answered questions in flight and gave us an insightful description of the sights before us. Great playlist too! A must do experience!

I wanted to do something special with my girl, and the truth is they had me at "Champagne".  Picture ice cold bubbly, my girl cuddled next to me, the Maui Sunset, her growing smile that became plastered permanently for the hour...WIN-WIN!  Highly recommended - DO IT!  Great pilot, amazing experience, worth it! We WILL remember this hour for the rest of our lives! Thanks so much MauiPlaneRides.com

A wonderful flightaround Kuaui, seeing many of the sights that you can see in no other way!

Very friendly and informative staff!

Highly recommended!

Super moment passé avec notre pilote Olsen, il nous a bien tout expliqué !
Super cool le mec  avec sa playlist oldschool dans l'hélico, j'ai vraiment apprécié !

review_title: Don’t Miss the Grand Denali tour!
review_text: If the sun is out, as it was for us, the Grand Denali flight is not to be missed. It was a memorable and very exciting experience. Don’t bother driving 3+ hours to Denali NP, you cannot see Denali from there, and can only travel into the Park 14 miles. The commentary from the pilot added greatly to the trip.

review_title: Better late than never! I did this 5.5 years ago and LOVED IT!
review_text:
It's Alyssa Jacey, the singer/songwriter you hosted on the private helicopter tour! I have been MEANING to review this and my only excuse is that I went on tour! I've opened for Bruno Mars, PEPPER, Andy Grammer, Lisa Loeb, Tavana and about 20 others! Anyway, enough about me. THIS TRIP WAS OUTSTANDING! I loved every second. It was so gorgeous, I felt very safe, they had a clean, comfortable heli...it was all wonderful. Not to mention their staff! LOVED them. So sweet, genuine...there was a lovely girl there at the time that hand drew me a map of the island...just to have! Anyway, I'll be coming back my next time to the island! I'll be on my 3rd tour in a year next month (June 7-19) to HNL. Visit Alyssa Jacey dot com for show details, maybe you can come to one of the nine?? 

To all considering Wings Over Kauai...stop hesitating and do it! You'll love it!

Sincerely,
~Alyssa Jacey
The vistas were lovely, but my 11 year old was underwhelmed and fell asleep on the ride back. In the future, I might do this trip with my husband and leave the kids on the ship.

review_title: Maybe not as thrilling as a helicopter ride, but cheaper and safer!
review_text:
We chose the GCA Visionary tour based primarily on safety (helicopter accidents @GC are much more common than fixed wing ones) and secondly on price (its a lot cheaper than a helicopter, and you can find a 2-1 voucher on the internet if you look, which works out slightly cheaper than the online discounted price per person).

Firstly I should say that everything ran smoothly. Pickup from hotel was on time, only a short wait at Boulder City Airport and we were off. From my seat I could see the cockpit and assessed (as a former pilot) the pilot and co-pilot (the latter was in charge of the aircraft whilst airborne) to be very professional.The return trip to LV was also prompt.

I very much enjoyed the tour. Alas my partner kept her eyes front for the whole duration because she was too scared to look out of the window! We chose the early morning set off, but I suspect that a later flight might give better lighting for photos and videos.

Okay, the flight could have gone further along the canyon. And whilst you get a good view, it is  perhaps not as great as with a helicopter. But if you are short on time and have a limited budget, but still want to experience the Grand Canyon, then this is a good option.

Flying with Wings Over Kauai was a wonderful experience.  The reservation process was easy and they were very flexible in order to accommodate our schedule. When we arrived everyone was extremely friendly and the checkin process was a breeze. Bruce informed us there was some haze and checked the weather to see if the next few days would offer better viewing.  Since there was some rain in the forecast we decided to go that day, and we were happy we did. We took the smaller Cessna plane.  Bruce was a wonderful pilot - it was an extremely smooth flight and Bruce was a great guide.  And the sights were awesome.  This is a great alternative for people who are nervous about helicopters (like me) or who have weight limits and cannot take a helicopter.

review_title: Delighted with our choice of plane over helicopter
review_text:
We debated helicopter vs plane  and eventually decided on the plane because we would see more and have more time in the air for less money.  I was also motivated by the fact that planes are safer than helicopters and use less gas. 

We were delighted with our choice. We were made feel so welcome by Bruce and his daughter - charming people. Our pilot was Marcus. I was nervous because he is young but he has great credentials and inspires confidence.  He did a great job telling us about Kauai. 

 The weather wasn't good so I was nervous about a bumpy ride but Marcus knew exactly where the smooth spots were while still showing us everything.  We each had a big window and could talk to each other over the headsets. My husband loved being in the co-pilot seat. We had a great time and highly recommend.
